"""Bounded FP32-tensor FastF32 attention hypothesis; no production policy."""

"""Stdlib owned parent; the worker alone imports the inference framework."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

from benchmarks.analysis.torch.process import launch


class Arguments(argparse.Namespace):
    model: Path
    manifest: Path
    manifest_sha256: str
    sources: Path
    sources_sha256: str
    control: Path
    control_sha256: str
    batch_size: int
    output: Path
    worker: bool


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model", type=Path)
    for field in ("manifest", "sources", "control"):
        parser.add_argument(f"--{field}", type=Path, required=True)
        parser.add_argument(f"--{field}-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, choices=(1, 8), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(namespace=Arguments())
    if args.worker:
        from .study import study

        return (
            0
            if study(
                args.model,
                args.output,
                manifest=args.manifest,
                manifest_sha256=args.manifest_sha256,
                sources=args.sources,
                sources_sha256=args.sources_sha256,
                control=args.control,
                control_sha256=args.control_sha256,
                batch_size=args.batch_size,
            )
            else 1
        )
    return launch(
        "benchmarks.analysis.cuda.attention.run",
        args.model,
        args.output,
        timeout=180,
        worker_args=(
            "--manifest",
            str(args.manifest),
            "--manifest-sha256",
            args.manifest_sha256,
            "--sources",
            str(args.sources),
            "--sources-sha256",
            args.sources_sha256,
            "--control",
            str(args.control),
            "--control-sha256",
            args.control_sha256,
            "--batch-size",
            str(args.batch_size),
        ),
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""First-eight quality and actual dispatch; no ordinary latency verdict."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from collections import Counter
from dataclasses import asdict, replace
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

import torch
from torch import nn
from transformers import masking_utils
from transformers.integrations import sdpa_attention
from transformers.models.qwen3 import modeling_qwen3

from benchmarks.analysis.cuda.manifest import (
    DATA,
    DATA_SHA,
    INPUT_SHA,
    MODEL_ID,
    REFERENCE,
    ROOT,
    asset_paths,
    digest,
)
from benchmarks.analysis.cuda.scorer import FP32Scorer, ieee_precision, require_fp32
from benchmarks.analysis.cuda.study import (
    admit,
    admit_control,
    control_cycle,
    occupancy,
)
from benchmarks.analysis.evidence import freeze_sources
from benchmarks.analysis.reference import read_reference
from wyat import Model
from wyat.backends.kai.artifact import load_artifact
from wyat.backends.kai.torch import KaiScorer
from wyat.benchmark import (
    BenchmarkCycle,
    BenchmarkEngine,
    QualityGate,
    _run,
    compare_cycles,
)
from wyat.core import Scorer
from wyat.evaluation import _input_digest, case_from_dict
from wyat.wire import decode_json, read_object

from .scorer import efficient_scorer
from .trace import efficient_dispatch_gate, profile_batch

SOURCES = (
    Path("benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/__init__.py"),
    Path("benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/scorer.py"),
    Path("benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/study.py"),
    Path("benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/trace.py"),
    Path("benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/run.py"),
    Path("tests/analysis/test_cuda_attention.py"),
    Path("docs/analysis/attention.md"),
)


def admit_sources(path: Path, sha256: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    if digest(path) != sha256:
        raise ValueError("New source declaration differs from reviewed identity")
    saved = read_object(path)
    if set(saved) != {str(item) for item in SOURCES}:
        raise ValueError("New source declaration must contain every exact source")
    hashes = cast(dict[str, str], saved)
    if any(digest(ROOT / name) != value for name, value in hashes.items()):
        raise ValueError("New experiment source bytes changed")
    return hashes


def check_cycle(
    cycle: BenchmarkCycle,
    reference: BenchmarkCycle,
    control: BenchmarkCycle,
) -> tuple[bool, dict[str, object]]:
    if tuple(row.id for row in cycle.rows) != tuple(row.id for row in reference.rows):
        raise ValueError("Returned cycle is incomplete or reorders canonical cases")
    cpu_drift = compare_cycles((reference,), (cycle,), QualityGate())
    cuda_drift = compare_cycles((control,), (cycle,), QualityGate())
    return cpu_drift.passed and cuda_drift.passed, {
        "cpu_reference": asdict(cpu_drift),
        "cuda_control": asdict(cuda_drift),
    }


def study(
    model: Path,
    output: Path,
    *,
    manifest: Path,
    manifest_sha256: str,
    sources: Path,
    sources_sha256: str,
    control: Path,
    control_sha256: str,
    batch_size: int,
) -> bool:
    if type(batch_size) is not int or batch_size not in (1, 8):
        raise ValueError("First-eight diagnostic requires batch1/8")
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "completed": False,
        "quality_passed": False,
        "dispatch_passed": False,
        "accepted": False,
        "scope": "first8 pinned BANKING77 training-source; model exposure unknown",
        "gate": asdict(QualityGate()),
        "attention": "FP32 tensor efficient candidate; CUTLASS FastF32, not IEEE",
        "gemm_head": "IEEE global/CUDA matmul; FP32 weights/head, no autocast",
        "limitations": [
            "No speed/promotion claim",
            "Instantaneous occupancy does not reserve hardware",
            "Missing/unstarted outcomes unknown",
        ],
    }

    def write() -> None:
        output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

    write()
    try:
        if digest(manifest) != manifest_sha256:
            raise ValueError("Original manifest changed")
        admission = admit(manifest)
        source_hashes = admit_sources(sources, sources_sha256)
        pinned = admit_control(
            control, control_sha256, admission, batch_size=batch_size
        )
        hf_policy = {
            "mps_available": sdpa_attention._is_torch_mps_available,
            "xpu_available": sdpa_attention._is_torch_xpu_available,
            "npu_available": sdpa_attention._is_torch_npu_available,
        }
        payload["hf_availability"] = hf_policy
        if any(hf_policy.values()):
            raise ValueError("Screen requires the frozen Linux CUDA HF policy")
        payload.update(
            admission=admission,
            control=pinned,
            source_declaration_sha256=sources_sha256,
        )
        paths = {
            str(path): ROOT / path
            for path in (*asset_paths(), *SOURCES)
            if path.suffix in (".py", ".md")
        }
        paths.update(
            external_qwen3=Path(modeling_qwen3.__file__),
            external_sdpa=Path(sdpa_attention.__file__),
            external_masking=Path(masking_utils.__file__),
        )
        frozen = freeze_sources(paths, output)
        payload.update(source_sha256=frozen.hashes(), source_archive=frozen.archive())
        if load_artifact(model, 512).model_id != MODEL_ID:
            raise ValueError("Model identity differs from frozen control")
        full = tuple(
            case_from_dict(decode_json(line))
            for line in (ROOT / DATA).read_text().splitlines()
        )
        if len(full) != 77 or _input_digest(full) != INPUT_SHA:
            raise ValueError("Canonical full cohort changed")
        cases = full[:8]
        profiled = cases[:batch_size]
        payload.update(
            case_ids=[case.id for case in cases],
            profiled_case_ids=[case.id for case in profiled],
            expected_ordinary_rows=16,
            expected_profile_rows=2 * len(profiled),
        )
        payload["unknown_case_ids"] = {
            f"{name}_{phase}": [case.id for case in selected]
            for name in ("math", "efficient")
            for phase, selected in (("ordinary", cases), ("profile", profiled))
        }
        payload["occupancy_before"] = occupancy()
        torch.set_num_threads(8)
        base = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model, device="cpu", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
        )
        reference = read_reference(
            ROOT / REFERENCE, full, base, dataset_sha256=DATA_SHA
        )
        cuda = control_cycle(control, full)
        if not compare_cycles((reference,), (cuda,), QualityGate()).passed:
            raise ValueError("Reviewed CUDA control fails unchanged CPU gates")
        reference, cuda = (
            replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[:8]),
            replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[:8]),
        )
        payload["occupancy_before_allocation"] = occupancy()
        with ieee_precision():
            base.device = torch.device("cuda:0")
            cast(nn.Module, base.backbone).to(base.device)
            base.head.to(base.device)
            require_fp32(base)
            payload["weight_dtypes"] = {
                "backbone": dict(
                    Counter(str(p.dtype) for p in base.backbone.parameters())
                ),
                "head": dict(Counter(str(p.dtype) for p in base.head.parameters())),
            }
            engines: tuple[tuple[str, Scorer], ...] = (
                ("math", FP32Scorer(base)),
                ("efficient", efficient_scorer(base)),
            )
            for name, scorer in engines:
                chunks: list[BenchmarkCycle] = []
                payload["phase"] = f"ordinary_{name}"
                for offset in range(0, len(cases), batch_size):
                    occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
                    chunk = _run(
                        BenchmarkEngine(
                            name,
                            Model(scorer, model_id=MODEL_ID),
                            batch_size=batch_size,
                        ),
                        cases[offset : offset + batch_size],
                    )
                    chunks.append(chunk)
                    payload[f"{name}_completed_batches"] = [
                        item.to_dict() for item in chunks
                    ]
                    cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"])[
                        f"{name}_ordinary"
                    ] = [
                        case.id
                        for case in cases
                        if case.id
                        not in {row.id for item in chunks for row in item.rows}
                    ]
                    write()
                    if chunk.failed:
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"{name} ordinary backend/output failure; no profiles"
                        )
                cycle = BenchmarkCycle(
                    sum(item.latency_ms for item in chunks),
                    tuple(row for item in chunks for row in item.rows),
                    chunks[0].peak_rss_before_bytes,
                    chunks[-1].peak_rss_after_bytes,
                )
                payload[f"{name}_cycle"] = cycle.to_dict()
                passed, drift = check_cycle(cycle, reference, cuda)
                payload[f"{name}_drift"] = drift
                write()
                if not passed:
                    raise ValueError(f"{name} numerical/rank drift; profiles unstarted")
            for name, scorer in engines:
                occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
                payload["phase"] = f"profile_{name}"
                write()
                cycle, trace = profile_batch(scorer, profiled, name=name)
                payload[f"{name}_profile"] = trace
                payload[f"{name}_profile_cycle"] = cycle.to_dict()
                cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"])[
                    f"{name}_profile"
                ] = [
                    case.id
                    for case in profiled
                    if case.id not in {row.id for row in cycle.rows}
                ]
                expected = replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[: len(profiled)])
                cuda_expected = replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[: len(profiled)])
                passed, drift = check_cycle(cycle, expected, cuda_expected)
                payload[f"{name}_profile_drift"] = drift
                write()
                if not passed:
                    raise ValueError(f"{name} profiled numerical/rank drift")
            length = max(
                len(base.encode_request(case.request).ids) for case in profiled
            )
            candidate_trace = cast(dict[str, object], payload["efficient_profile"])
            dispatch_passed = efficient_dispatch_gate(
                candidate_trace,
                batch_size=len(profiled),
                length=length,
            )
            payload["dispatch_passed"] = dispatch_passed
            payload["cuda_memory"] = {
                "peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                "peak_reserved_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(),
            }
            payload["occupancy_after"] = occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
        if (
            digest(manifest) != manifest_sha256
            or admit(manifest) != admission
            or admit_sources(sources, sources_sha256) != source_hashes
            or digest(control) != pinned["sha256"]
            or digest(Path(cast(str, pinned["wall_path"]))) != pinned["wall_sha256"]
            or any(digest(Path(item.path)) != item.sha256 for item in frozen.files)
        ):
            raise ValueError("Consumed identity/source changed during diagnostics")
        payload.update(
            completed=True,
            quality_passed=True,
            phase="completed",
            torch_build=torch.__config__.show(),
        )
        write()
        return dispatch_passed
    except Exception as error:
        payload.update(
            completed=False,
            quality_passed=False,
            dispatch_passed=False,
            accepted=False,
            phase="failed",
            error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
        )
        write()
        return False

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse

from benchmarks.analysis.torch.process import launch


class Arguments(argparse.Namespace):
    model: Path
    output: Path
    manifest: Path
    manifest_sha256: str
    sources: Path

    control: Path

    confirmation_sha256: str | None
    confirmation_wall_sha256: str | None
    worker: bool


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    for field in ("manifest", "sources", "control"):
        parser.add_argument(f"--{field}", type=Path, required=True)
        parser.add_argument(f"--{field}-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=("confirm", "timing"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, choices=(1, 8), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--confirmation", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--confirmation-sha256")
    parser.add_argument("--confirmation-wall-sha256")
    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(namespace=Arguments())
    if args.worker:
        from .study import study

        return (
            0
            if study(
                args.model,
                args.output,
                manifest=args.manifest,
                manifest_sha256=args.manifest_sha256,
                sources=args.sources,
                sources_sha256=args.sources_sha256,
                control=args.control,
                control_sha256=args.control_sha256,
                mode=args.mode,
                batch_size=args.batch_size,
                confirmation=args.confirmation,
                confirmation_sha256=args.confirmation_sha256,
                confirmation_wall_sha256=args.confirmation_wall_sha256,
            )
            else 1
        )
    if any(
        path.exists()
        for path in (
            args.output,
            args.output.with_suffix(".wall.json"),
            args.output.with_suffix(".log"),
        )
    ):
        raise ValueError("A new trial must not overwrite an existing receipt/wall/log")
    options = [
        "--mode",
        args.mode,
        "--batch-size",
        str(args.batch_size),
        "--manifest",
        str(args.manifest),
        "--manifest-sha256",
        args.manifest_sha256,
        "--sources",
        str(args.sources),
        "--sources-sha256",
        args.sources_sha256,
        "--control",
        str(args.control),
        "--control-sha256",
        args.control_sha256,
    ]
    if args.confirmation is not None:
        options.extend(("--confirmation", str(args.confirmation)))
    if args.confirmation_sha256 is not None:
        options.extend(("--confirmation-sha256", args.confirmation_sha256))
    if args.confirmation_wall_sha256 is not None:
        options.extend(("--confirmation-wall-sha256", args.confirmation_wall_sha256))
    return launch(
        "benchmarks.analysis.cuda.latency.run",
        args.model,
        args.output,
        timeout=180,
        worker_args=tuple(options),
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

@dataclass(slots=True)
class ReferenceInput:
    """Validate the exact tokenizer contract before loading checkpoint tensors."""

    model_id: str
    encoder: KaiEncoder

    def encode_request(self, request: Request) -> EncodedRequest:
        return self.encoder.encode_request(request)


def source_paths() -> dict[str, Path]:
    paths = {
        str(path): ROOT / path
        for path in (*asset_paths(), *ATTENTION_SOURCES, *SOURCES)
        if path.suffix in (".py", ".md")
    }
    paths.update(
        external_qwen3=Path(modeling_qwen3.__file__),
        external_sdpa=Path(sdpa_attention.__file__),
        external_masking=Path(masking_utils.__file__),
    )
    return paths


def admit_sources(path: Path, sha256: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    if digest(path) != sha256:
        raise ValueError("Latency source declaration changed")
    saved = cast(dict[str, str], read_object(path))
    if set(saved) != {str(item) for item in SOURCES} or any(
        digest(ROOT / name) != value for name, value in saved.items()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Every exact latency source is required unchanged")
    return saved


def read_cycle(value: object, cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...]) -> BenchmarkCycle:
    saved = cast(dict[str, object], value)
    raw = cast(list[dict[str, object]], saved["rows"])
    if len(raw) != len(cases):
        raise ValueError("History cycle must cover its entire canonical cohort")
    rows: list[EvaluationRow] = []
    for item, case in zip(raw, cases, strict=True):
        prediction = cast(dict[str, object], item["prediction"])
        decision = decision_from_logits(
            case.request, cast(list[float], prediction["scores"]), MODEL_ID
        )
        correct = decision.selected in case.expected
        if (
            item["id"] != case.id
            or item["expected"] != list(case.expected)
            or item["status"] != "ok"
            or item["error"] is not None
            or prediction != decision.to_dict()
            or item["correct"] != correct
        ):
            raise ValueError("History output is failed, reordered or inconsistent")
        rows.append(
            EvaluationRow(
                case.id,
                case.expected,
                "ok",
                decision,
                correct,
                float(cast(float, item["latency_ms"])),
                None,
            )
        )
    return BenchmarkCycle(
        float(cast(float, saved["latency_ms"])),
        tuple(rows),
        int(cast(int, saved["peak_rss_before_bytes"])),
        int(cast(int, saved["peak_rss_after_bytes"])),
    )


def require_parent(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    wall = read_object(path.with_suffix(".wall.json"))
    if (
        wall.get("exit_code") != 0
        or wall.get("completed") is not True
        or wall.get("timed_out") is not False
        or wall.get("timeout_seconds") != 180
    ):
        raise ValueError("History parent failed terminal cleanup or its owned cap")
    return cast(dict[str, object], wall)


def admit_screens(
    reference: BenchmarkCycle, cuda: BenchmarkCycle, cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...]
) -> dict[str, str]:
    pins = {str(ATTENTION_DECLARATION): ATTENTION_SHA}
    admit_attention(ROOT / ATTENTION_DECLARATION, ATTENTION_SHA)
    for batch, (main_sha, wall_sha) in SCREEN_PINS.items():
        path = (
            ROOT / f"benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-attention-observer-b{batch}.json"
        )
        archive = path.with_suffix(".sources-686a18493cecf093.json")
        for item, expected in (
            (path, main_sha),
            (path.with_suffix(".wall.json"), wall_sha),
            (archive, ARCHIVE_SHA),
        ):
            if digest(item) != expected:
                raise ValueError("Reviewed attention screen history changed")
            pins[str(item.relative_to(ROOT))] = expected
        saved = read_object(path)
        require_parent(path)
        current = source_paths()
        if any(
            name not in current or digest(current[name]) != sha
            for name, sha in cast(dict[str, str], saved["source_sha256"]).items()
        ):
            raise ValueError("Consumed screen sources, including external HF, changed")
        if (
            saved.get("completed") is not True
            or saved.get("quality_passed") is not True
            or saved.get("dispatch_passed") is not True
            or saved.get("accepted") is not False
            or saved.get("batch_size") != batch
            or saved.get("source_declaration_sha256") != ATTENTION_SHA
            or saved.get("case_ids") != [case.id for case in cases[:8]]
            or any(cast(dict[str, list[str]], saved["unknown_case_ids"]).values())
        ):
            raise ValueError("Reviewed attention screen is incomplete")
        for arm in ("math", "efficient"):
            for phase, cohort in (
                ("cycle", cases[:8]),
                ("profile_cycle", cases[:batch]),
            ):
                cycle = read_cycle(saved[f"{arm}_{phase}"], cohort)
                passed, _ = check_cycle(
                    cycle,
                    replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[: len(cohort)]),
                    replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[: len(cohort)]),
                )
                if not passed:
                    raise ValueError("Reviewed screen fails unchanged CPU/CUDA gates")
        if not efficient_dispatch_gate(
            cast(dict[str, object], saved["efficient_profile"]),
            batch_size=batch,
            length=172 if batch == 1 else 192,
        ):
            raise ValueError("Reviewed representative screen dispatch is unsupported")
    return pins


def admit_confirmation(
    path: Path | None,
    sha256: str | None,
    *,
    wall_sha256: str | None,
    batch_size: int,
    source_hashes: dict[str, str],
    reference: BenchmarkCycle,
    cuda: BenchmarkCycle,
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
) -> dict[str, str]:
    if (
        path is None
        or sha256 is None
        or wall_sha256 is None
        or digest(path) != sha256
        or digest(path.with_suffix(".wall.json")) != wall_sha256
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Timing requires an independently reviewed confirmation identity"
        )
    saved = read_object(path)
    require_parent(path)
    if (
        saved.get("mode") != "confirm"
        or saved.get("batch_size") != batch_size
        or saved.get("completed") is not True
        or saved.get("quality_passed") is not True
        or saved.get("dispatch_passed") is not True
        or saved.get("accepted") is not False
        or saved.get("case_ids") != [case.id for case in cases]
        or saved.get("input_sha256") != INPUT_SHA
        or cast(dict[str, str], saved["new_source_hashes"]) != source_hashes
        or any(cast(dict[str, list[str]], saved["unknown_case_ids"]).values())
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Confirmation is incomplete or differs from the timing contract"
        )
    current = source_paths()
    hashes = cast(dict[str, str], saved["source_sha256"])
    if set(hashes) != set(current) or any(
        digest(current[name]) != sha for name, sha in hashes.items()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Confirmation source identity differs from current execution")
    archive = cast(dict[str, str], saved["source_archive"])
    archive_path = path.with_suffix(f".sources-{archive['sha256'][:16]}.json")
    if digest(archive_path) != archive["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Confirmation source archive changed")
    cycles = cast(list[dict[str, object]], saved["cycles"])
    if [item.get("key") for item in cycles] != ["confirm_math", "confirm_efficient"]:
        raise ValueError("Confirmation must contain both complete ordinary arms")
    paired: list[BenchmarkCycle] = []
    for item in cycles:
        cycle = read_cycle(item["cycle"], cases)
        if not check_cycle(cycle, reference, cuda)[0]:
            raise ValueError("Confirmation fails unchanged CPU/CUDA numerical gates")
        paired.append(cycle)
    if not compare_cycles((paired[0],), (paired[1],), QualityGate()).passed:
        raise ValueError("Confirmation arms fail paired quality")
    profiled = cases[:batch_size]
    for arm in ("math", "efficient"):
        cycle = read_cycle(saved[f"{arm}_profile_cycle"], profiled)
        if not check_cycle(
            cycle,
            replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[:batch_size]),
            replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[:batch_size]),
        )[0]:
            raise ValueError("Confirmation profile output fails unchanged quality")
    if not efficient_dispatch_gate(
        cast(dict[str, object], saved["efficient_profile"]),
        batch_size=batch_size,
        length=172 if batch_size == 1 else 192,
    ):
        raise ValueError("Confirmation profile is not the reviewed efficient dispatch")
    return {
        str(path): sha256,
        str(path.with_suffix(".wall.json")): wall_sha256,
        str(archive_path): archive["sha256"],
    }


def cycle_data(cycle: BenchmarkCycle) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Keep unsupported timing evidence JSON-safe without losing returned rows."""
    saved = cycle.to_dict()
    invalid: dict[str, str] = {}
    if not math.isfinite(cycle.latency_ms):
        invalid["latency_ms"] = repr(cycle.latency_ms)
        saved["latency_ms"] = None
    for row in cast(list[dict[str, object]], saved["rows"]):
        value = cast(float, row["latency_ms"])
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            invalid[f"row:{row['id']}"] = repr(value)
            row["latency_ms"] = None
    if invalid:
        saved["invalid_timing"] = invalid
    return saved


def collect(
    engine: BenchmarkEngine,
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
    reference: BenchmarkCycle,
    cuda: BenchmarkCycle,
    *,
    key: str,
    payload: dict[str, object],
    write: Callable[[], None],
    verify: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
) -> BenchmarkCycle:
    """Ownership and persistence surround, never enter, canonical batch timers."""
    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    chunks: list[BenchmarkCycle] = []
    observations: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    record: dict[str, object] = {
        "key": key,
        "chunks": [],
        "ownership": observations,
        "drift": [],
    }
    cast(list[dict[str, object]], payload["cycles"]).append(record)
    unknown = cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"])
    for offset in range(0, len(cases), engine.batch_size):
        if verify is not None:
            verify()
        observations.append(
            {
                "utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                "offset": offset,
                "snapshot": occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid()),
            }
        )
        cohort = cases[offset : offset + engine.batch_size]
        chunk = _run(engine, cohort)
        chunks.append(chunk)
        cast(list[dict[str, object]], record["chunks"]).append(cycle_data(chunk))
        unknown[key] = [
            case.id
            for case in cases
            if case.id not in {row.id for item in chunks for row in item.rows}
        ]
        try:
            passed, drift = check_cycle(
                chunk,
                replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[offset : offset + len(cohort)]),
                replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[offset : offset + len(cohort)]),
            )
            cast(list[dict[str, object]], record["drift"]).append(drift)
        finally:
            # One retained update per returned batch, also on gate exceptions.
            write()
        if chunk.failed or not passed:
            raise ValueError(f"{key} batch failed unchanged quality gates")
        if (
            not math.isfinite(chunk.latency_ms)
            or chunk.latency_ms <= 0
            or any(
                not math.isfinite(row.latency_ms) or row.latency_ms < 0
                for row in chunk.rows
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError("Canonical batch interval must be finite and positive")
    cycle = BenchmarkCycle(
        math.fsum(item.latency_ms for item in chunks),
        tuple(row for item in chunks for row in item.rows),
        chunks[0].peak_rss_before_bytes,
        chunks[-1].peak_rss_after_bytes,
    )
    record.update(
        cycle=cycle.to_dict(), cohort_wall_ms=(time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
    )
    write()
    return cycle


def performance(
    baseline: tuple[BenchmarkCycle, ...], candidate: tuple[BenchmarkCycle, ...]
) -> dict[str, object]:
    if len(baseline) != 6 or len(candidate) != 6:
        raise ValueError("Six complete paired cohorts are required")
    left, right = (
        [item.latency_ms for item in baseline],
        [item.latency_ms for item in candidate],
    )
    if any(not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0 for value in (*left, *right)):
        raise ValueError("Paired intervals must be finite and positive")
    ratios = [a / b for a, b in zip(left, right, strict=True)]
    median, low = percentile(ratios, 0.5), percentile(ratios, 0.05)
    aggregate = math.fsum(left) / math.fsum(right)
    tail = percentile(right, 0.95) / percentile(left, 0.95)
    return {
        "paired_ratios": ratios,
        "median": median,
        "p05": low,
        "aggregate": aggregate,
        "cohort_p95_ratio": tail,
        "passed": median >= 1.05 and low > 1 and aggregate > 1 and tail <= 1,
    }


def study(
    model: Path,
    output: Path,
    *,
    manifest: Path,
    manifest_sha256: str,
    sources: Path,
    sources_sha256: str,
    control: Path,
    control_sha256: str,
    mode: Mode,
    batch_size: int,
    confirmation: Path | None = None,
    confirmation_sha256: str | None = None,
    confirmation_wall_sha256: str | None = None,
) -> bool:
    if (
        mode not in ("confirm", "timing")
        or type(batch_size) is not int
        or batch_size not in (1, 8)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Use a declared confirmation/timing mode and batch1/8")
    if mode == "confirm" and (
        confirmation is not None
        or confirmation_sha256 is not None
        or confirmation_wall_sha256 is not None
    ):
        raise ValueError("Confirmation must not consume another confirmation")
    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "mode": mode,
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "completed": False,
        "quality_passed": False,
        "dispatch_passed": False,
        "dispatch_evidence_scope": (
            "prior representative confirmation profile; timed calls unprofiled"
            if mode == "timing"
            else (
                "current representative first-batch profile; "
                "ordinary cohorts unprofiled"
            )
        ),
        "performance_passed": False,
        "accepted": False,
        "cycles": [],
        "scope": "Pinned77 BANKING77 training-source menus; exposure unknown",
        "gate": asdict(QualityGate()),
        "input_sha256": INPUT_SHA,
        "timing_scope": (
            "Sum synchronized _run(batch).latency_ms including row bookkeeping; "
            "telemetry-paced; excludes ownership/I/O/quality/gaps"
        ),
        "limitations": [
            "No online capacity/tail or universal speed claim",
            "Instantaneous ownership is not a reservation",
            "Unstarted outcomes unknown; profiler is diagnostic only",
            "FP32 tensors do not imply IEEE efficient-attention arithmetic",
        ],
    }

    def write() -> None:
        output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

    # The worker owns this new receipt; never replace another trial's history.
    with output.open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(payload, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    try:
        if manifest_sha256 != MANIFEST_SHA or digest(manifest) != MANIFEST_SHA:
            raise ValueError(
                "Only the original immutable 44-asset manifest is admitted"
            )
        admission = admit(manifest)
        new_hashes = admit_sources(sources, sources_sha256)
        admit_attention(ROOT / ATTENTION_DECLARATION, ATTENTION_SHA)
        if (
            control_sha256 != CONTROL_SHA
            or digest(control.with_suffix(".wall.json")) != CONTROL_WALL_SHA
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Only the reviewed original CUDA control/main wall is admitted"
            )
        pinned = admit_control(
            control, control_sha256, admission, batch_size=batch_size
        )
        payload.update(
            admission=admission,
            control=pinned,
            new_source_hashes=new_hashes,
            source_declaration_sha256=sources_sha256,
        )
        if any(
            (
                sdpa_attention._is_torch_mps_available,
                sdpa_attention._is_torch_xpu_available,
                sdpa_attention._is_torch_npu_available,
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "This experiment requires frozen Linux CUDA HF availability"
            )
        frozen = freeze_sources(source_paths(), output)
        payload.update(source_sha256=frozen.hashes(), source_archive=frozen.archive())
        artifact = load_artifact(model, 512)
        if artifact.model_id != MODEL_ID:
            raise ValueError("Checkpoint identity differs from the frozen reference")
        cases = tuple(
            case_from_dict(decode_json(line))
            for line in (ROOT / DATA).read_text().splitlines()
        )
        if len(cases) != 77 or _input_digest(cases) != INPUT_SHA:
            raise ValueError("Every exact canonical case must remain ordered")
        payload.update(
            case_ids=[case.id for case in cases],
            expected_ordinary_rows=154 if mode == "confirm" else 1078,
            expected_profile_rows=2 * batch_size if mode == "confirm" else 0,
        )
        schedule = (
            [("confirm", None, ("math", "efficient"))]
            if mode == "confirm"
            else [("warmup", None, ("math", "efficient"))]
            + [
                (
                    "pair",
                    repeat,
                    ("math", "efficient") if repeat % 2 == 0 else ("efficient", "math"),
                )
                for repeat in range(6)
            ]
        )
        keys = [
            f"{phase}{'' if repeat is None else repeat}_{arm}"
            for phase, repeat, order in schedule
            for arm in order
        ]
        payload["unknown_case_ids"] = {key: [case.id for case in cases] for key in keys}
        if mode == "confirm":
            cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"]).update(
                {
                    f"{arm}_profile": [case.id for case in cases[:batch_size]]
                    for arm in ("math", "efficient")
                }
            )
        write()
        inputs = ReferenceInput(
            artifact.model_id,
            KaiEncoder.from_artifact(artifact, max_length=512, token_cache_size=0),
        )
        reference = read_reference(
            ROOT / REFERENCE, cases, inputs, dataset_sha256=DATA_SHA
        )
        cuda = control_cycle(control, cases)
        if not compare_cycles((reference,), (cuda,), QualityGate()).passed:
            raise ValueError("Reviewed CUDA control fails the original CPU reference")
        history = admit_screens(reference, cuda, cases)
        if mode == "timing":
            confirmed = admit_confirmation(
                confirmation,
                confirmation_sha256,
                wall_sha256=confirmation_wall_sha256,
                batch_size=batch_size,
                source_hashes=new_hashes,
                reference=reference,
                cuda=cuda,
                cases=cases,
            )
            history.update(confirmed)
            payload.update(confirmation=confirmed, dispatch_passed=True)
        payload["history_sha256"] = history

        def verify() -> None:
            if any(digest(Path(item.path)) != item.sha256 for item in frozen.files):
                raise ValueError("Consumed source changed between inference batches")

        payload["occupancy_before_load"] = occupancy()
        write()
        torch.set_num_threads(8)
        base = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model, device="cpu", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
        )
        read_reference(ROOT / REFERENCE, cases, base, dataset_sha256=DATA_SHA)
        payload["occupancy_before_allocation"] = occupancy()
        with ieee_precision():
            base.device = torch.device("cuda:0")
            cast(nn.Module, base.backbone).to(base.device)
            base.head.to(base.device)
            require_fp32(base)
            scorers: dict[str, Scorer] = {
                "math": FP32Scorer(base),
                "efficient": efficient_scorer(base),
            }
            engines = {
                arm: BenchmarkEngine(
                    arm,
                    Model(scorer, model_id=MODEL_ID),
                    batch_size=batch_size,
                    synchronize=torch.cuda.synchronize,
                )
                for arm, scorer in scorers.items()
            }
            measured: dict[str, list[BenchmarkCycle]] = {"math": [], "efficient": []}
            warm: dict[str, list[BenchmarkCycle]] = {"math": [], "efficient": []}
            for phase, repeat, order in schedule:
                current: dict[str, BenchmarkCycle] = {}
                for arm in order:
                    key = f"{phase}{'' if repeat is None else repeat}_{arm}"
                    payload["phase"] = key
                    write()
                    current[arm] = collect(
                        engines[arm],
                        cases,
                        reference,
                        cuda,
                        key=key,
                        payload=payload,
                        write=write,
                        verify=verify,
                    )
                    if phase == "warmup":
                        warm[arm].append(current[arm])
                    elif phase == "pair":
                        measured[arm].append(current[arm])
                drift = compare_cycles(
                    (current["math"],), (current["efficient"],), QualityGate()
                )
                payload[f"{phase}{'' if repeat is None else repeat}_paired_drift"] = (
                    asdict(drift)
                )
                write()
                if not drift.passed:
                    raise ValueError("Paired arms fail unchanged quality gates")
            if mode == "confirm":
                profiled = cases[:batch_size]
                for arm in ("math", "efficient"):
                    payload["phase"] = f"{arm}_profile"
                    occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
                    write()
                    cycle, observed = profile_batch(scorers[arm], profiled, name=arm)
                    payload[f"{arm}_profile_cycle"] = cycle_data(cycle)
                    payload[f"{arm}_profile"] = observed
                    cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"])[
                        f"{arm}_profile"
                    ] = [
                        case.id
                        for case in profiled
                        if case.id not in {row.id for row in cycle.rows}
                    ]
                    passed, profile_drift = check_cycle(
                        cycle,
                        replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[:batch_size]),
                        replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[:batch_size]),
                    )
                    payload[f"{arm}_profile_drift"] = profile_drift
                    write()
                    if not passed:
                        raise ValueError("Representative profile quality failed")
                payload["dispatch_passed"] = efficient_dispatch_gate(
                    cast(dict[str, object], payload["efficient_profile"]),
                    batch_size=batch_size,
                    length=max(
                        len(base.encode_request(case.request).ids) for case in profiled
                    ),
                )
                if payload["dispatch_passed"] is not True:
                    raise ValueError("Representative efficient dispatch is unsupported")
            else:
                left, right = tuple(measured["math"]), tuple(measured["efficient"])
                report = BenchmarkReport(
                    INPUT_SHA,
                    cases,
                    BenchmarkProtocol(repeats=6, warmup=1),
                    engines["math"],
                    engines["efficient"],
                    left,
                    right,
                    compare_cycles(left, right, QualityGate()),
                    tuple(warm["math"]),
                    tuple(warm["efficient"]),
                ).to_dict()
                cast(dict[str, object], report["protocol"])["timing"] = payload[
                    "timing_scope"
                ]
                payload.update(report=report, performance=performance(left, right))
                payload["performance_passed"] = cast(
                    dict[str, object], payload["performance"]
                )["passed"]
            payload["occupancy_after"] = occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
            payload["cuda_memory"] = {
                "peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                "peak_reserved_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(),
            }
        admit_attention(ROOT / ATTENTION_DECLARATION, ATTENTION_SHA)
        if (
            admit(manifest) != admission
            or admit_sources(sources, sources_sha256) != new_hashes
            or any(digest(ROOT / path) != sha for path, sha in history.items())
            or digest(control) != pinned["sha256"]
            or digest(Path(cast(str, pinned["wall_path"]))) != pinned["wall_sha256"]
            or any(digest(Path(item.path)) != item.sha256 for item in frozen.files)
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Consumed source/reference/history changed during execution"
            )
        payload.update(
            completed=True,
            quality_passed=True,
            phase="completed",
            worker_body_wall_ms=(time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6,
            torch_build=torch.__config__.show(),
        )
        write()
        return mode == "confirm" or payload["performance_passed"] is True
    except Exception as error:
        payload.update(
            completed=False,
            quality_passed=False,
            dispatch_passed=False,
            performance_passed=False,
            accepted=False,
            phase="failed",
            error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
        )
        write()
        return False

def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        return hashlib.file_digest(source, "sha256").hexdigest()


def asset_paths(root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
    helpers = (
        "benchmarks/__init__.py",
        "benchmarks/analysis/__init__.py",
        "benchmarks/analysis/evidence.py",
        "benchmarks/analysis/reference.py",
        "benchmarks/analysis/torch/process.py",
        "docs/analysis/cuda.md",
        "docs/analysis/cuda-run.md",
        "tests/analysis/test_cuda_protocol.py",
    )
    return tuple(
        sorted(
            set(
                [path.relative_to(root) for path in (root / "wyat").rglob("*.py")]
                + [
                    path.relative_to(root)
                    for path in (root / "benchmarks/analysis/cuda").glob("*.py")
                ]
                + [Path(path) for path in helpers]
                + [MODEL / path for path in MODEL_FILES]
                + [DATA, REFERENCE]
            )
        )
    )


def freeze(path: Path, root: Path = ROOT) -> None:
    if digest(root / DATA) != DATA_SHA or digest(root / REFERENCE) != REFERENCE_SHA:
        raise ValueError("Pinned data/reference changed")
    payload = {
        "model_id": MODEL_ID,
        "dataset_sha256": DATA_SHA,
        "reference_sha256": REFERENCE_SHA,
        "input_sha256": INPUT_SHA,
        "versions": PACKAGES,
        "runtime": RUNTIME,
        "files": [
            {
                "path": str(item),
                "sha256": digest(root / item),
                "bytes": (root / item).stat().st_size,
            }
            for item in asset_paths(root)
        ],
    }
    with path.open("x") as target:
        json.dump(payload, target, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        target.write("\n")

            0
            if study(
                args.model,
                args.output,
                manifest=args.manifest,
                manifest_sha256=args.manifest_sha256,
                arm=args.arm,
                batch_size=args.batch_size,
                control=args.control,
                control_sha256=args.control_sha256,
            )
            else 1
        )
    extra: tuple[str, ...] = (
        "--manifest",
        str(args.manifest),
        "--manifest-sha256",
        args.manifest_sha256,
        "--arm",
        args.arm,
        "--batch-size",
        str(args.batch_size),
    )
    if args.control is not None:
        extra += ("--control", str(args.control))
    if args.control_sha256 is not None:
        extra += ("--control-sha256", args.control_sha256)
    return launch(
        "benchmarks.analysis.cuda.run",
        args.model,
        args.output,
        timeout=180,
        worker_args=extra,
    )

"""An explicit FP32 control, independent of the production CUDA autocast path."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterator, Sequence
from contextlib import contextmanager
from typing import Protocol, cast

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn.attention import SDPBackend, sdpa_kernel
from transformers.modeling_outputs import BaseModelOutputWithPast

from wyat.backends.kai.torch import KaiScorer
from wyat.core import Request


class PrecisionOwner(Protocol):
    fp32_precision: str


@contextmanager
def ieee_precision() -> Iterator[None]:
    """This owned process requires modern controls; never mix legacy TF32 flags.

    https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.12/notes/cuda.html
    """
    global_owner = cast(PrecisionOwner, torch.backends)
    old_global = global_owner.fp32_precision
    old_matmul = torch.backends.cuda.matmul.fp32_precision
    try:
        global_owner.fp32_precision = "ieee"
        torch.backends.cuda.matmul.fp32_precision = "ieee"
        yield
    finally:
        torch.backends.cuda.matmul.fp32_precision = old_matmul
        global_owner.fp32_precision = old_global


def require_fp32(scorer: KaiScorer) -> None:
    for owner in (cast(nn.Module, scorer.backbone), scorer.head):
        for name, value in (*owner.named_parameters(), *owner.named_buffers()):
            if value.is_floating_point() and value.dtype != torch.float32:
                raise ValueError(f"FP32 control has non-FP32 tensor: {name}")


class FP32Scorer:
    """Same encoder/head and endpoint contract; no nested BF16-enabled scorer."""

    def __init__(self, base: KaiScorer) -> None:
        require_fp32(base)
        self.base = base

    def score_many(self, requests: Sequence[Request]) -> list[list[float]]:
        if not requests:
            return []
        base = self.base
        encoded = [base.encode_request(request) for request in requests]
        length = max(len(row.ids) for row in encoded)
        width = max(len(row.candidate_positions) for row in encoded)
        batch = len(encoded)
        ids = torch.full((batch, length), base.pad_id, dtype=torch.long)
        endpoints = torch.zeros((batch, width), dtype=torch.long)
        for index, row in enumerate(encoded):
            ids[index, : len(row.ids)] = torch.tensor(row.ids, dtype=torch.long)
            endpoints[index, : len(row.candidate_positions)] = torch.tensor(
                row.candidate_positions, dtype=torch.long
            )
        ids, endpoints = ids.to(base.device), endpoints.to(base.device)
        rows = torch.arange(batch, device=base.device)
        query = torch.tensor(
            [row.query_position for row in encoded], device=base.device
        )
        with (
            torch.inference_mode(),
            torch.autocast(device_type=base.device.type, enabled=False),
            sdpa_kernel(SDPBackend.MATH),
        ):
            output = cast(
                BaseModelOutputWithPast,
                base.backbone(input_ids=ids, use_cache=False),
            )
            hidden = output.last_hidden_state
            if hidden is None or hidden.dtype != torch.float32:
                raise ValueError("FP32 control requires FP32 hidden states")
            logits = cast(
                torch.Tensor,
                base.head(hidden[rows[:, None], endpoints], hidden[rows, query]),
            )
            if logits.dtype != torch.float32:
                raise ValueError("FP32 control requires FP32 head output")
        values = cast(list[list[float]], logits.cpu().tolist())
        return [
            row[: len(item.candidate_positions)]
            for row, item in zip(values, encoded, strict=True)
        ]

type Arm = Literal["fp32", "released"]


def dtype_gate(
    events: list[dict[str, object]],
    arm: Arm,
    calls: int,
    weights: dict[str, dict[str, int]],
) -> bool:
    expected_roles = ["q_proj", "gate_proj", "head"] * calls
    if [event["role"] for event in events] != expected_roles:
        return False
    if set(weights["head"]) != {"torch.float32"}:
        return False
    if arm == "fp32" and set(weights["backbone"]) != {"torch.float32"}:
        return False
    return all(
        event["output_dtype"]
        == (
            "torch.float32"
            if arm == "fp32" or event["role"] == "head"
            else "torch.bfloat16"
        )
        and event["autocast_enabled"] is (arm == "released")
        for event in events
    )


def occupancy(*, own_pid: int | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Instantaneous observation, not a reservation; reject other compute owners."""
    gpu = subprocess.run(
        [
            "nvidia-smi",
            "--query-gpu=name,uuid,memory.total,memory.used,utilization.gpu",
            "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=5,
        check=True,
    ).stdout.strip()
    apps = subprocess.run(
        [
            "nvidia-smi",
            "--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory",
            "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=5,
        check=True,
    ).stdout.strip()
    rows = [row.strip() for row in gpu.splitlines()]
    if len(rows) != 1:
        raise ValueError("This experiment requires exactly one visible GPU")
    name, uuid, total, used, utilization = rows[0].split(", ")
    foreign = [row for row in apps.splitlines() if int(row.split(",")[0]) != own_pid]
    if foreign or (own_pid is None and (int(utilization) != 0 or int(used) > 256)):
        raise ValueError(f"GPU busy; no authorized interference: {gpu}; {apps}")
    return {
        "gpu": gpu,
        "compute_apps": apps,
        "uuid": uuid,
        "name": name,
        "memory_total_MiB": int(total),
        "memory_used_MiB": int(used),
        "utilization_percent": int(utilization),
        "exclusive": False,
    }


def admit(manifest: Path, root: Path = ROOT) -> dict[str, object]:
    declared = read_object(manifest)
    expected = {
        "model_id": MODEL_ID,
        "dataset_sha256": DATA_SHA,
        "reference_sha256": REFERENCE_SHA,
        "input_sha256": INPUT_SHA,
    }
    if any(declared.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()):
        raise ValueError("Manifest canonical identities changed")
    files = cast(list[dict[str, object]], declared["files"])
    if [item["path"] for item in files] != [str(p) for p in asset_paths(root)]:
        raise ValueError("Manifest must contain every declared asset exactly once")
    for item in files:
        path = root / cast(str, item["path"])
        if path.stat().st_size != item["bytes"] or digest(path) != item["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError(f"Transferred asset changed: {path}")
    actual = {name: version(name) for name in PACKAGES}
    runtime = {
        "python": platform.python_version(),
        "torch_runtime": str(torch.__version__),
        "cuda_build": torch.version.cuda,
    }
    if (
        actual != PACKAGES
        or runtime != RUNTIME
        or actual != declared["versions"]
        or runtime != declared["runtime"]
    ):
        raise ValueError(f"Runtime differs from prospective declaration: {actual}")
    if digest(root / DATA) != DATA_SHA or digest(root / REFERENCE) != REFERENCE_SHA:
        raise ValueError("Canonical data/reference bytes changed")
    return {
        **expected,
        "manifest_sha256": digest(manifest),
        "asset_count": len(files),
        "versions": actual,
        "runtime": runtime,
    }


def admit_control(
    path: Path | None,
    sha256: str | None,
    admission: dict[str, object],
    *,
    batch_size: int,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    if path is None or sha256 is None or digest(path) != sha256:
        raise ValueError("A reviewed immutable FP32 B1 receipt is required")
    control = read_object(path)
    wall_path = path.with_suffix(".wall.json")
    wall = read_object(wall_path)
    if (
        wall.get("exit_code") != 0
        or wall.get("completed") is not True
        or wall.get("timed_out") is not False
        or wall.get("timeout_seconds") != 180
    ):
        raise ValueError("FP32 control parent did not complete safe terminal cleanup")
    if (
        control.get("completed") is not True
        or control.get("quality_passed") is not True
        or control.get("arm") != "fp32"
        or control.get("batch_size") != 1
        or control.get("admission") != admission
    ):
        raise ValueError("FP32 B1 control incomplete or canonical identity differs")
    if batch_size == 8:
        memory = cast(dict[str, int], control["cuda_memory"])
        total = cast(dict[str, int], control["occupancy_before"])[
            "memory_total_MiB"
        ] * (1 << 20)
        if memory["peak_reserved_bytes"] >= total * 0.6:
            raise ValueError("B1 memory leaves insufficient prospective B8 margin")
    return {
        "path": str(path),
        "sha256": sha256,
        "wall_path": str(wall_path),
        "wall_sha256": digest(wall_path),
    }


def control_cycle(path: Path, cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...]) -> BenchmarkCycle:
    """Reconstruct all rows from scores and reject incomplete or inconsistent claims."""
    saved = cast(dict[str, object], read_object(path)["cycle"])
    rows = cast(list[dict[str, object]], saved["rows"])
    if len(rows) != len(cases):
        raise ValueError("CUDA control must contain every canonical row")
    reconstructed: list[EvaluationRow] = []
    for row, case in zip(rows, cases, strict=True):
        prediction = cast(dict[str, object], row["prediction"])
        if row["id"] != case.id or row["status"] != "ok" or row["error"] is not None:
            raise ValueError("CUDA control contains missing/failed or reordered rows")
        decision = decision_from_logits(
            case.request, cast(list[float], prediction["scores"]), MODEL_ID
        )
        correct = decision.selected in case.expected
        if (
            prediction != decision.to_dict()
            or row["correct"] != correct
            or row["expected"] != list(case.expected)
        ):
            raise ValueError("CUDA control interpretation differs from recorded scores")
        reconstructed.append(
            EvaluationRow(case.id, case.expected, "ok", decision, correct, 0, None)
        )
    return BenchmarkCycle(0, tuple(reconstructed), 0, 0)


def study(
    model: Path,
    output: Path,
    *,
    manifest: Path,
    manifest_sha256: str,
    arm: Arm,
    batch_size: int,
    control: Path | None = None,
    control_sha256: str | None = None,
) -> bool:
    if (
        arm not in ("fp32", "released")
        or type(batch_size) is not int
        or batch_size not in (1, 8)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Use fp32/released and batch1/8")
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "arm": arm,
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "completed": False,
        "quality_passed": False,
        "accepted": False,
        "scope": "full77 BANKING77 training-source quality; exposure unknown",
        "gate": asdict(QualityGate()),
        "precision": "modern IEEE global/CUDA matmul",
        "attention": "math only" if arm == "fp32" else "maintained SDPA selection",
        "limitations": [
            "No warm/repeated timing claim; no promotion",
            "Occupancy snapshots do not reserve shared hardware",
            "Raw completed batches retained; interrupted/unstarted rows unknown",
        ],
    }

    def write() -> None:
        output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

    write()
    handles: list[torch.utils.hooks.RemovableHandle] = []
    try:
        if digest(manifest) != manifest_sha256:
            raise ValueError("Manifest differs from root-reviewed immutable identity")
        admission = admit(manifest)
        payload["admission"] = admission
        if arm == "released" or batch_size == 8:
            payload["control"] = admit_control(
                control, control_sha256, admission, batch_size=batch_size
            )
        sources = {
            str(path): ROOT / path for path in asset_paths() if path.suffix == ".py"
        }
        sources["external_qwen3"] = Path(modeling_qwen3.__file__)
        sources["external_sdpa"] = Path(sdpa_attention.__file__)
        frozen = freeze_sources(sources, output)
        payload.update(source_sha256=frozen.hashes(), source_archive=frozen.archive())
        artifact = load_artifact(model, 512)
        if artifact.model_id != MODEL_ID:
            raise ValueError("Loaded artifact differs from frozen model")
        cases = tuple(
            case_from_dict(decode_json(line))
            for line in (ROOT / DATA).read_text().splitlines()
        )
        if len(cases) != 77 or _input_digest(cases) != INPUT_SHA:
            raise ValueError("Full canonical cohort changed")
        payload["occupancy_before"] = occupancy()
        torch.set_num_threads(8)
        base = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model, device="cpu", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
        )
        reference = read_reference(
            ROOT / REFERENCE, cases, base, dataset_sha256=DATA_SHA
        )
        cuda_reference = None if control is None else control_cycle(control, cases)
        if (
            cuda_reference is not None
            and not compare_cycles(
                (reference,), (cuda_reference,), QualityGate()
            ).passed
        ):
            raise ValueError("Admitted CUDA control no longer passes strict CPU gates")
        payload["occupancy_before_allocation"] = occupancy()
        with ieee_precision():
            scorer: Scorer
            if arm == "fp32":
                require_fp32(base)
                base.device = torch.device("cuda:0")
                cast(nn.Module, base.backbone).to(base.device)
                base.head.to(base.device)
                require_fp32(base)
                scorer = FP32Scorer(base)
            else:
                del base
                base = KaiScorer.from_directory(
                    model, device="cuda:0", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
                )
                scorer = base
            dtype_events: list[dict[str, object]] = []

            def record(
                role: str, module: nn.Module, inputs: tuple[object, ...], result: object
            ) -> None:
                if isinstance(result, torch.Tensor):
                    dtype_events.append(
                        {
                            "module": type(module).__name__,
                            "role": role,
                            "input_dtypes": [
                                str(value.dtype)
                                for value in inputs
                                if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor)
                            ],
                            "output_dtype": str(result.dtype),
                            "autocast_enabled": torch.is_autocast_enabled("cuda"),
                        }
                    )

            modules = dict(cast(nn.Module, base.backbone).named_modules())
            for role, module in (
                ("q_proj", modules["layers.0.self_attn.q_proj"]),
                ("gate_proj", modules["layers.0.mlp.gate_proj"]),
                ("head", base.head),
            ):
                handles.append(module.register_forward_hook(partial(record, role)))
            payload["weight_dtypes"] = {
                "backbone": dict(
                    Counter(str(p.dtype) for p in base.backbone.parameters())
                ),
                "head": dict(Counter(str(p.dtype) for p in base.head.parameters())),
            }
            torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
            payload["phase"] = "quality_cohort"
            payload["expected_rows"] = 77
            payload["dtype_events"] = dtype_events
            write()
            engine = BenchmarkEngine(
                arm, Model(scorer, model_id=MODEL_ID), batch_size=batch_size
            )
            chunks: list[BenchmarkCycle] = []
            for offset in range(0, 77, batch_size):
                occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
                chunks.append(_run(engine, cases[offset : offset + batch_size]))
                payload["completed_batches"] = [chunk.to_dict() for chunk in chunks]
                payload["completed_rows"] = sum(len(chunk.rows) for chunk in chunks)
                payload["unknown_case_ids"] = [
                    case.id for case in cases[offset + batch_size :]
                ]
                write()
            cycle = BenchmarkCycle(
                sum(chunk.latency_ms for chunk in chunks),
                tuple(row for chunk in chunks for row in chunk.rows),
                chunks[0].peak_rss_before_bytes,
                chunks[-1].peak_rss_after_bytes,
            )
            payload["cycle"] = cycle.to_dict()
            payload["dtype_events"] = dtype_events
            payload["dtype_passed"] = dtype_gate(
                dtype_events,
                arm,
                (77 + batch_size - 1) // batch_size,
                cast(dict[str, dict[str, int]], payload["weight_dtypes"]),
            )
            payload["cuda_memory"] = {
                "allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.memory_allocated(),
                "reserved_bytes": torch.cuda.memory_reserved(),
                "peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                "peak_reserved_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(),
            }
            drift = compare_cycles((reference,), (cycle,), QualityGate())
            payload["drift"] = asdict(drift)
            cuda_drift = (
                None
                if cuda_reference is None
                else compare_cycles((cuda_reference,), (cycle,), QualityGate())
            )
            payload["cuda_control_drift"] = (
                None if cuda_drift is None else asdict(cuda_drift)
            )
            payload["occupancy_after"] = occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
            if (
                digest(manifest) != manifest_sha256
                or admit(manifest) != admission
                or any(
                    digest(Path(source.path)) != source.sha256
                    for source in frozen.files
                )
            ):
                raise ValueError("Consumed source/assets changed during cohort")
            if control is not None:
                pinned = cast(dict[str, str], payload["control"])
                if (
                    digest(control) != pinned["sha256"]
                    or digest(Path(pinned["wall_path"])) != pinned["wall_sha256"]
                ):
                    raise ValueError("Consumed CUDA control/wall changed during cohort")
            while handles:
                handles.pop().remove()
        # Successful state is published only after hook and IEEE-state cleanup.
        payload.update(
            completed=True,
            quality_passed=drift.passed
            and len(cycle.rows) == 77
            and payload["dtype_passed"] is True
            and (cuda_drift is None or cuda_drift.passed),
            phase="completed",
            torch_build=torch.__config__.show(),
        )
        write()
        return cast(bool, payload["quality_passed"])
    except Exception as error:
        payload.update(
            completed=False,
            quality_passed=False,
            accepted=False,
            error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
            phase="failed",
        )
        write()
        return False
    finally:
        for handle in handles:
            try:
                handle.remove()
            except Exception as error:
                payload.update(
                    completed=False,
                    quality_passed=False,
                    accepted=False,
                    cleanup_error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
                )
                write()

"""Small immutable source snapshots and untimed process observations."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import resource
import time
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SourceFile:
    name: str
    path: str
    sha256: str
    text: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FrozenSources:
    files: tuple[SourceFile, ...]
    archive_path: str
    archive_sha256: str

    def hashes(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return {source.name: source.sha256 for source in self.files}

    def archive(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return {"path": self.archive_path, "sha256": self.archive_sha256}


def freeze_sources(paths: Mapping[str, Path], output: Path) -> FrozenSources:
    """Read declared small source files once and retain their exact UTF-8 bytes.

    A content-addressed exclusive-create archive is never overwritten. The
    snapshot describes on-disk source at setup; it is not checkpoint storage
    or proof that external dependencies match those bytes.
    """
    sources: list[SourceFile] = []
    for name, path in sorted(paths.items()):
        data = path.read_bytes()
        sources.append(
            SourceFile(
                name, str(path), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), data.decode("utf-8")
            )
        )
    payload = (
        json.dumps(
            {"schema_version": 1, "files": [asdict(source) for source in sources]},
            indent=2,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            allow_nan=False,
        )
        + "\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")
    archive_hash = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
    archive = output.with_suffix(f".sources-{archive_hash[:16]}.json")
    archive.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        with archive.open("xb") as stream:
            stream.write(payload)
    except FileExistsError:
        if archive.read_bytes() != payload:
            raise ValueError(
                "Existing source archive differs from its identity"
            ) from None
    return FrozenSources(tuple(sources), str(archive), archive_hash)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ProcessDiagnostic:
    wall_time_ns: int
    perf_counter_ns: int
    user_seconds: float
    system_seconds: float
    minor_faults: int
    major_faults: int
    voluntary_context_switches: int
    involuntary_context_switches: int
    load_average: tuple[float, float, float] | None
    load_average_error: str | None
    collection_elapsed_ns: int
    device_memory_bytes: dict[str, int] | None = None


def process_diagnostic(
    *, device_memory_bytes: Mapping[str, int] | None = None
) -> ProcessDiagnostic:
    """Read cumulative own-process counters; no causal interpretation is implied."""
    start = time.perf_counter_ns()
    wall = time.time_ns()
    usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
    load: tuple[float, float, float] | None = None
    error: str | None = None
    try:
        load = os.getloadavg()
    except (AttributeError, OSError) as exc:
        error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
    return ProcessDiagnostic(
        wall,
        start,
        usage.ru_utime,
        usage.ru_stime,
        usage.ru_minflt,
        usage.ru_majflt,
        usage.ru_nvcsw,
        usage.ru_nivcsw,
        load,
        error,
        time.perf_counter_ns() - start,
        None if device_memory_bytes is None else dict(device_memory_bytes),
    )

def exact_bfloat_linear(original: Linear) -> Linear:
    """Finite, value-exact BF16 parameters; approximation belongs to products."""
    weight = original.weight
    if weight.dtype != mx.float32 or "bias" in original:
        raise ValueError("Requires bias-free FP32 source projection")
    converted = weight.astype(mx.bfloat16)
    source, restored = weight.reshape(-1), converted.astype(mx.float32).reshape(-1)
    for start in range(0, source.size, 1 << 18):
        before, after = (
            source[start : start + (1 << 18)],
            restored[start : start + (1 << 18)],
        )
        if not bool(mx.all(mx.isfinite(before) & (before == after)).item()):
            raise ValueError("Projection parameters are not finite exact BF16 values")
    projection = Linear(weight.shape[1], weight.shape[0], bias=False)
    projection.weight = converted
    mx.eval(projection.weight)
    return projection


def product(projection: Linear, value: mx.array) -> mx.array:
    expected = projection.weight.dtype
    if expected not in (mx.bfloat16, mx.float32) or value.dtype != expected:
        raise ValueError("Declared projection operands must share their dtype")
    result = projection(value)
    if result.dtype != expected:
        raise ValueError("Unexpected projection promotion changes the declared recipe")
    return result.astype(mx.float32)


class BFloatMLP(Module):
    def __init__(self, original: MLP, arm: Arm) -> None:
        super().__init__()  # type: ignore[no-untyped-call]  # Maintained Module boundary.
        if arm not in ARMS:
            raise ValueError("Unknown fixed BF16 role arm")
        self.gate_up_reduced = arm in ("all-gate-up", "all-mlp")
        self.down_reduced = arm in ("all-down", "all-mlp")
        self.gate_proj = (
            exact_bfloat_linear(original.gate_proj)
            if self.gate_up_reduced
            else original.gate_proj
        )
        self.up_proj = (
            exact_bfloat_linear(original.up_proj)
            if self.gate_up_reduced
            else original.up_proj
        )
        self.down_proj = (
            exact_bfloat_linear(original.down_proj)
            if self.down_reduced
            else original.down_proj
        )

    def __call__(self, x: mx.array) -> mx.array:
        if x.dtype != mx.float32:
            raise ValueError("MLP input/SwiGLU must remain FP32")
        gate_input = x.astype(mx.bfloat16) if self.gate_up_reduced else x
        gate = product(self.gate_proj, gate_input)
        up = product(self.up_proj, gate_input)
        activation = cast(Callable[[mx.array, mx.array], mx.array], swiglu)(gate, up)
        down_input = activation.astype(mx.bfloat16) if self.down_reduced else activation
        return product(self.down_proj, down_input)


class MutableBlock(Protocol):
    mlp: ArrayMap


def candidate_backbone(original: Qwen3Model, arm: Arm) -> Qwen3Model:
    """Fresh module owners; unchanged FP32 arrays are shared, never mutated."""
    if arm not in ARMS:
        raise ValueError("Unknown fixed BF16 role arm")
    candidate = Qwen3Model(original.args)
    parameters = cast(Callable[[], object], original.parameters)()
    flattened = cast(list[tuple[str, mx.array]], tree_flatten(parameters))
    candidate.load_weights(flattened, strict=True)
    for block in cast(Sequence[MutableBlock], candidate.layers):
        block.mlp = BFloatMLP(cast(MLP, block.mlp), arm)
    candidate.eval()
    return candidate

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib

from argparse import ArgumentParser, Namespace
