def save(output: Path, payload: dict[str, object]) -> None:
    output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def admit(
    model: Path,
) -> tuple[
    tuple[EvaluationCase, ...], BenchmarkCycle, tuple[int, ...], dict[str, object]
]:
    """Model bytes and every reference token are checked before model allocation."""
    for name, expected in PRODUCTION.items():
        if hashlib.sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected:
            raise ValueError("Declared production capture source changed")
    dataset = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/banking77-train-dev-menu6.jsonl"
    reference_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/torch-fp32-reference77.json"
    dataset_bytes = dataset.read_bytes()
    if (
        hashlib.sha256(dataset_bytes).hexdigest() != DATASET_SHA256
        or hashlib.sha256(reference_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != REFERENCE_SHA256
    ):
        raise ValueError("Frozen dataset/reference bytes changed")
    cases = tuple(
        case_from_dict(decode_json(line))
        for line in dataset_bytes.decode().splitlines()
    )
    if len(cases) != 77 or len({case.id for case in cases}) != 77:
        raise ValueError("Frozen cohort requires all77 unique rows")
    artifact = load_artifact(model, max_length=512)
    if artifact.model_id != MODEL_ID:
        raise ValueError("Frozen model identity changed")
    encoder = KaiEncoder.from_artifact(artifact, max_length=512, token_cache_size=0)

    class ReferenceInput:
        model_id = artifact.model_id
        encode_request = encoder.encode_request

    reference = read_reference(
        reference_path, cases, ReferenceInput(), dataset_sha256=DATASET_SHA256
    )
    selected = cases[:8]
    tokens = tuple(encoder.encode_request(case.request) for case in selected)
    prefix = tokens[0].ids[:25]
    if (
        any(item.ids[:25] != prefix for item in tokens)
        or len(tokens[7].ids) != 192
        or max(len(item.ids) for item in tokens) != 192
    ):
        raise ValueError("Declared scalar/batch/prefix token geometry changed")
    evidence: dict[str, object] = {
        "model_id": artifact.model_id,
        "dataset_sha256": DATASET_SHA256,
        "reference_sha256": REFERENCE_SHA256,
        "input_sha256": _input_digest(selected),
        "prefix_tokens": list(prefix),
        "scalar_case_index": 7,
        "cases": [
            {
                "id": case.id,
                "token_ids": list(item.ids),
                "candidate_positions": list(item.candidate_positions),
                "query_position": item.query_position,
                "token_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                    json.dumps(list(item.ids), separators=(",", ":")).encode()
                ).hexdigest(),
            }
            for case, item in zip(selected, tokens, strict=True)
        ],
    }
    return selected, BenchmarkCycle(0, reference.rows[:8], 0, 0), prefix, evidence


def capture_all(
    model: Path,
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
    reference: BenchmarkCycle,
    prefix: tuple[int, ...],
    *,
    progress: Callable[[dict[str, object]], None],
) -> tuple[
    dict[str, np.ndarray[tuple[int, int], np.dtype[np.float32]]], dict[str, object]
]:
    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    base = MLXKaiScorer.from_directory(
        model, max_length=512, token_cache_size=0, compile=False, device="gpu"
    )
    mx.synchronize(mx.gpu)
    load_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
    prefix_started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    cached = PrefixScorer(base, prefix)
    mx.synchronize(mx.gpu)
    prefix_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - prefix_started) / 1e6
    owners = tuple(
        weakref.ref(owner) for owner in (base, cached, base.backbone, base.head)
    )
    arrays: dict[str, np.ndarray[tuple[int, int], np.dtype[np.float32]]] = {}
    receipts: dict[str, object] = {
        "model_load_ms": load_ms,
        "prefix_build_ms": prefix_ms,
    }
    try:
        arrays["weight"] = detached_float32(
            base.backbone.layers[0].mlp.gate_proj.weight
        )
        if arrays["weight"].shape != (3072, 1024) or not exact_bfloat_bits(
            arrays["weight"]
        ):
            raise ValueError("Gate weight cannot decode from BF16 bitwise exactly")
        for name, batch, rows in SHAPES:
            cohort = cases if batch == 8 else (cases[7],)
            control = (
                reference
                if batch == 8
                else BenchmarkCycle(0, (reference.rows[7],), 0, 0)
            )
            try:
                captured = capture_input(
                    base,
                    cached if name.startswith("prefix") else base,
                    cohort,
                    batch_size=batch,
                    expected_rows=rows,
                )
            except CaptureFailure as error:
                receipts[name] = {"cycle": error.cycle.to_dict(), "error": str(error)}
                progress(receipts)
                raise
            gate = compare_cycles((control,), (captured.cycle,), QualityGate())
            arrays[name] = captured.values
            receipts[name] = {
                **captured.metadata(),
                "case_ids": [case.id for case in cohort],
                "cycle": captured.cycle.to_dict(),
                "cpu_quality": asdict(gate),
            }
            progress(receipts)
        del captured
    finally:
        del cached, base
        gc.collect()
        mx.synchronize(mx.gpu)
        mx.clear_cache()
    if any(owner() is not None for owner in owners):
        raise ValueError("Capture retained a model/resource owner")
    receipts.update(
        model_owners_released=True,
        capture_elapsed_ms=(time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6,
        memory_after_release=memory(),
    )
    return arrays, receipts


def performance(blocks: list[dict[str, object]]) -> dict[str, object]:
    ratios: list[float] = []
    for block in blocks:
        totals = cast(dict[str, list[int]], block["dispatch_ns"])
        if set(totals) != set(ARMS) or any(
            len(values) != 10
            or any(type(value) is not int or value <= 0 for value in values)
            for values in totals.values()
        ):
            raise ValueError("Performance requires all30 positive timings per block")
        ratios.append(sum(totals["maintained"]) / sum(totals["custom-bf16"]))
    if (
        len(blocks) != 6
        or tuple(tuple(cast(list[str], block["order"])) for block in blocks) != ORDERS
    ):
        raise ValueError("Performance requires allsix balanced permutations")
    median, p05 = percentile(ratios, 0.5), percentile(ratios, 0.05)
    return {
        "paired_ratios": ratios,
        "paired_median": median,
        "paired_p05": p05,
        "passed": median >= 1.05 and p05 > 1,
    }


def output_digest(value: mx.array) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(detached_float32(value).tobytes()).hexdigest()


@contextmanager
def restored_cache(payload: dict[str, object]) -> Iterator[int]:
    failure: BaseException | None = None
    payload["cache_cap_restoration_completed"] = False
    try:
        with bounded_cache(512 << 20) as previous:
            payload["original_cache_cap_bytes"] = previous
            try:
                yield previous
            except BaseException as error:
                failure = error
        payload["cache_cap_restoration_completed"] = True
        payload["cache_cap_restored_bytes"] = previous
    except BaseException as error:
        payload["cache_cap_restoration_error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
        raise
    if failure is not None:
        raise failure


def study(model: Path, output: Path) -> bool:
    if output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve prior projection receipts")
    if os.environ.get("MLX_ENABLE_TF32") != "0":
        raise ValueError("Disable TF32 before importing MLX")
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "completed": False,
        "accepted": False,
        "python": sys.version,
        "platform": platform.platform(),
        "tf32": os.environ.get("MLX_ENABLE_TF32"),
        "phase": "admission",
        "scope": (
            "first gate projection;8 unique training-source cases, exposure "
            "unknown; no complete inference speed claim"
        ),
        "protocol": {
            "shapes": SHAPES,
            "arms": ARMS,
            "orders": ORDERS,
            "dispatches_per_arm_block": 10,
            "partial_receipt": (
                "blocks saved after each complete arm; timeout within "
                "ten dispatches leaves that arm unknown"
            ),
            "cold_dispatches": 1,
            "warm_dispatches": 1,
            "cache_cap_bytes": 512 << 20,
            "timeout_seconds": 180,
            "atol": 1e-4,
            "rtol": 1e-4,
            "bitwise_storage_controls": True,
            "median_minimum": 1.05,
            "p05_exclusive_minimum": 1.0,
            "observation": (
                "every warmed/timed output hashed against its cold output "
                "outside dispatch timer; observations separate dispatches; "
                "not unobserved steady throughput"
            ),
        },
    }
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    save(output, payload)
    try:
        from .kernel import ProjectionKernel

        files = {
            str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): path
            for folder in (ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/mlx/mixed", ROOT / "wyat")
            for path in folder.rglob("*.py")
        }
        files.update(
            {
                name: ROOT / name
                for name in (
                    "docs/analysis/mixed.md",
                    "benchmarks/analysis/evidence.py",
                    "benchmarks/analysis/reference.py",
                    "benchmarks/analysis/torch/process.py",
                    "benchmarks/analysis/mlx/endpoints.py",
                    "benchmarks/analysis/mlx/bfloat/run.py",
                    "tests/analysis/test_mlx_mixed_capture.py",
                    "tests/analysis/test_mlx_mixed_kernel.py",
                )
            }
        )
        for name, source in (
            ("qwen3", qwen3),
            ("cache", cache),
            ("attention", maintained_base),
            ("module", module_base),
            ("linear", linear),
            ("normalization", normalization),
            ("activation", activations),
        ):
            files["maintained_" + name] = Path(inspect.getfile(source))
        mlx_root = Path(mx.__file__).resolve().parent
        for name in (
            "core/fast.pyi",
            "include/mlx/backend/metal/kernels/bf16.h",
            "include/mlx/backend/common/metal_kernel.h",
        ):
            files["maintained_mlx_" + name] = mlx_root / name
        frozen = freeze_sources(files, output)
        payload.update(source_hashes=frozen.hashes(), source_archive=frozen.archive())
        cases, reference, prefix, inputs = admit(model)
        payload.update(inputs)
        payload["phase"] = "capture"
        save(output, payload)
        with restored_cache(payload) as original_cap, mx.stream(mx.gpu):
            payload["original_cache_cap_bytes"] = original_cap
            payload["versions"] = {
                name: version(name) for name in ("mlx", "mlx-lm", "numpy")
            }
            payload["device"] = mx.device_info(mx.gpu)

            def capture_progress(receipts: dict[str, object]) -> None:
                payload["captures"] = receipts
                save(output, payload)

            arrays, captures = capture_all(
                model, cases, reference, prefix, progress=capture_progress
            )
            payload["captures"] = captures
            payload["weight"] = {
                "shape": list(arrays["weight"].shape),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(arrays["weight"].tobytes()).hexdigest(),
                "fp32_bytes": arrays["weight"].nbytes,
                "bfloat_bytes": arrays["weight"].size * 2,
                "exact_bfloat_decode": True,
            }
            tensor_path = output.with_suffix(".tensors.safetensors")
            if tensor_path.exists():
                raise FileExistsError("Preserve frozen tensor artifact")
            save_file(arrays, str(tensor_path))
            payload["captured_bytes"] = {
                "path": str(tensor_path),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(tensor_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            }
            quality = all(
                cast(
                    dict[str, object],
                    cast(dict[str, object], captures[name])["cpu_quality"],
                )["passed"]
                is True
                for name, _, _ in SHAPES
            )
            payload["capture_quality_passed"] = quality
            save(output, payload)
            if not quality:
                payload.update(completed=True, phase="capture-rejected")
            else:
                if any(
                    hashlib.sha256(Path(source.path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                    != source.sha256
                    for source in frozen.files
                ):
                    raise ValueError("Frozen assay source changed after capture")
                payload["phase"] = "projection-screen"
                save(output, payload)
                started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                kernel = ProjectionKernel()
                payload["kernel_creation_ms"] = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
                started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                w32 = mx.array(arrays["weight"], dtype=mx.float32)
                mx.eval(w32)
                mx.synchronize(mx.gpu)
                payload["fp32_weight_reconstruction_ms"] = (
                    time.perf_counter_ns() - started
                ) / 1e6
                started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                w16 = w32.astype(mx.bfloat16)
                mx.eval(w16)
                mx.synchronize(mx.gpu)
                payload["bfloat_weight_conversion_ms"] = (
                    time.perf_counter_ns() - started
                ) / 1e6
                decoded = detached_float32(w16.astype(mx.float32))
                if not np.array_equal(
                    decoded.view(np.uint32), arrays["weight"].view(np.uint32)
                ):
                    raise ValueError("Device BF16 decode changed weight bits")
                del decoded
                results: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
                operations: dict[str, dict[str, CallableProjection]] = {}
                cold_values: dict[
                    str, np.ndarray[tuple[int, int], np.dtype[np.float32]]
                ] = {}
                cold_hashes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
                for name, _, _ in SHAPES:
                    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                    x = mx.array(arrays[name], dtype=mx.float32)
                    mx.eval(x)
                    mx.synchronize(mx.gpu)
                    reconstruction_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
                    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                    fp32, bf16 = kernel.prepare(x, w32), kernel.prepare(x, w16)
                    preparation_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6

                    def maintained(x: mx.array = x) -> mx.array:
                        return x @ w32.T

                    calls: dict[str, CallableProjection] = {
                        "maintained": maintained,
                        "custom-fp32": fp32.run,
                        "custom-bf16": bf16.run,
                    }
                    operations[name] = calls
                    cold: dict[str, float] = {}
                    values: dict[
                        str, np.ndarray[tuple[int, int], np.dtype[np.float32]]
                    ] = {}
                    for arm in ARMS:
                        mx.synchronize(mx.gpu)
                        started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                        y = calls[arm]()
                        mx.eval(y)
                        mx.synchronize(mx.gpu)
                        cold[arm] = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
                        values[arm] = detached_float32(y)
                        del y
                    cold_hashes[name] = {
                        arm: hashlib.sha256(value.tobytes()).hexdigest()
                        for arm, value in values.items()
                    }
                    cold_values.update(
                        {name + "-" + arm: value for arm, value in values.items()}
                    )
                    controls_equal = np.array_equal(
                        values["custom-fp32"].view(np.uint32),
                        values["custom-bf16"].view(np.uint32),
                    )
                    gates = {
                        arm: projection_quality(values["maintained"], values[arm])
                        for arm in ARMS[1:]
                    }
                    results[name] = {
                        "input_reconstruction_ms": reconstruction_ms,
                        "preparation_ms": preparation_ms,
                        "cold_dispatch_ms": cold,
                        "cold_output_sha256": cold_hashes[name],
                        "quality": gates,
                        "custom_storage_bitwise_equal": controls_equal,
                        "passed": controls_equal
                        and all(gate["passed"] is True for gate in gates.values()),
                        "blocks": [],
                    }
                    payload["shapes"] = results
                    save(output, payload)
                cold_path = output.with_suffix(".outputs.tensors.safetensors")
                if cold_path.exists():
                    raise FileExistsError("Preserve cold projection outputs")
                save_file(cold_values, str(cold_path))
                payload["cold_outputs"] = {
                    "path": str(cold_path),
                    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(cold_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                }
                numerical = all(result["passed"] is True for result in results.values())
                payload["projection_quality_passed"] = numerical
                if numerical:
                    payload["phase"] = "timing"
                    save(output, payload)
                    for name, _, _ in SHAPES:
                        calls = operations[name]
                        warm_hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
                        for arm in ARMS:
                            y = calls[arm]()
                            mx.eval(y)
                            mx.synchronize(mx.gpu)
                            warm_hashes[arm] = output_digest(y)
                            del y
                        results[name]["warm_output_sha256"] = warm_hashes
                        if warm_hashes != cold_hashes[name]:
                            raise ValueError(
                                "Warm projection drifted from screened output"
                            )
                        blocks: list[dict[str, object]] = []
                        for order in ORDERS:
                            before = memory()
                            timings: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
                            output_hashes: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
                            block: dict[str, object] = {
                                "order": list(order),
                                "dispatch_ns": timings,
                                "output_sha256": output_hashes,
                                "completed": False,
                                "outputs_reproduce_cold": False,
                                "memory_before": before,
                            }
                            blocks.append(block)
                            results[name]["blocks"] = blocks
                            for arm in order:
                                timings[arm] = []
                                output_hashes[arm] = []
                                for _ in range(10):
                                    mx.synchronize(mx.gpu)
                                    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                                    y = calls[arm]()
                                    mx.eval(y)
                                    mx.synchronize(mx.gpu)
                                    timings[arm].append(
                                        time.perf_counter_ns() - started
                                    )
                                    output_hashes[arm].append(output_digest(y))
                                    del y
                                save(output, payload)
                            reproducible = all(
                                value == cold_hashes[name][arm]
                                for arm, hashes in output_hashes.items()
                                for value in hashes
                            )
                            block.update(
                                completed=True,
                                outputs_reproduce_cold=reproducible,
                                memory_after=memory(),
                            )
                            results[name]["blocks"] = blocks
                            save(output, payload)
                            if not reproducible:
                                raise ValueError(
                                    "Timed projection drifted from screened output"
                                )
                        results[name]["performance"] = performance(blocks)
                payload.update(
                    completed=True,
                    accepted=numerical
                    and all(
                        cast(
                            dict[str, object], results[name].get("performance", {})
                        ).get("passed")
                        is True
                        for name in ("prefix-b1", "prefix-b8")
                    ),
                    phase="complete",
                )
            payload.update(
                versions={name: version(name) for name in ("mlx", "mlx-lm", "numpy")},
                memory_before_cap_restoration=memory(),
            )
        payload["cache_cap_restored_bytes"] = original_cap
        payload["cache_cap_restoration_completed"] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        payload.update(
            completed=False, accepted=False, error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
        )
    finally:
        try:
            save(output, payload)
        except Exception as error:
            payload.update(
                completed=False,
                accepted=False,
                final_write_error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
            )
            save(output, payload)
    return payload["completed"] is True and payload["accepted"] is True

"""Test exact widths and length grouping without changing production batching."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from argparse import ArgumentParser, Namespace
from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Protocol, cast

import mlx.core as mx

from benchmarks.analysis.mlx.profile import quality
from wyat import Model, Request
from wyat.backends.kai.encoding import EncodedRequest
from wyat.backends.kai.mlx import MLXKaiScorer
from wyat.benchmark import BenchmarkEngine, BenchmarkProtocol, benchmark_pair
from wyat.evaluation import case_from_dict
from wyat.wire import decode_json


class ExactWidth(MLXKaiScorer):
    """Experimental packing change; causal positions and forward stay identical."""

    def score_many(self, requests: Sequence[Request]) -> list[list[float]]:
        if not requests:
            return []
        encoded = [self.encode_request(request) for request in requests]
        length = max(len(row.ids) for row in encoded)
        width = max(len(row.candidate_positions) for row in encoded)
        with mx.stream(self.device):
            ids = mx.array(
                [
                    list(row.ids) + [self.encoder.pad_id] * (length - len(row.ids))
                    for row in encoded
                ],
                dtype=mx.int32,
            )
            endpoints = mx.array(
                [
                    list(row.candidate_positions)
                    + [0] * (width - len(row.candidate_positions))
                    for row in encoded
                ],
                dtype=mx.int32,
            )
            positions = mx.array(
                [row.query_position for row in encoded], dtype=mx.int32
            )
            logits = self._forward(ids, endpoints, positions)
            mx.eval(logits)
            values = cast(list[list[float]], logits.tolist())
        return [
            row[: len(item.candidate_positions)]
            for row, item in zip(values, encoded, strict=True)
        ]


class EncodedScorer(Protocol):
    def encode_request(self, request: Request) -> EncodedRequest: ...

    def score_many(self, requests: Sequence[Request]) -> list[list[float]]: ...


class Microbatches:
    """Ready-cohort scheduler; sorting cost is included and output order restored.

    Sorting encodes requests to obtain actual lengths, then the unchanged scorer
    encodes each microbatch. This intentionally charges the candidate for that
    extra work. There is no online admission queue or latency claim.
    """

    def __init__(self, scorer: EncodedScorer, batch_size: int, *, sort: bool) -> None:
        if type(batch_size) is not int or batch_size < 1:
            raise ValueError("batch size must be a positive integer")
        self.scorer = scorer
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        self.sort = sort

    def score_many(self, requests: Sequence[Request]) -> list[list[float]]:
        order = list(range(len(requests)))
        if self.sort:
            lengths = [len(self.scorer.encode_request(row).ids) for row in requests]
            order.sort(key=lambda index: lengths[index])
        result: list[list[float]] = [[] for _ in requests]
        for offset in range(0, len(order), self.batch_size):
            indices = order[offset : offset + self.batch_size]
            values = self.scorer.score_many([requests[index] for index in indices])
            for index, row in zip(indices, values, strict=True):
                result[index] = row
        return result


class Arguments(Namespace):
    batch_size: int
    output: Path

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]

    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output",
        type=Path,
        default=root / "benchmarks/analysis/results/mlx-padding77-b8.json",
    )
    options = parser.parse_args(namespace=Arguments())
    options.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dataset = root / "benchmarks/real/banking77-train-dev-menu6.jsonl"
    cases = tuple(
        case_from_dict(decode_json(row)) for row in dataset.read_text().splitlines()
    )
    reference = decode_json(
        (root / "benchmarks/real/torch-fp32-reference77.json").read_text()
    )
    assert isinstance(reference, dict)
    dataset_hash = hashlib.sha256(dataset.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert dataset_hash == reference["dataset_sha256"]
    reference_rows = reference["rows"]
    assert isinstance(reference_rows, list)
    scorer = MLXKaiScorer.from_directory(
        root / ".models/Decision-2.0-Kai-0.6B",
        max_length=512,
        token_cache_size=0,
        device="gpu",
    )
    assert scorer.model_id == reference["model_id"]
    saved: list[list[float]] = []
    for case, row in zip(cases, reference_rows, strict=True):
        assert isinstance(row, dict)
        assert case.id == row["id"]
        encoded = scorer.encode_request(case.request)
        assert list(encoded.ids) == row["token_ids"]
        assert list(encoded.candidate_positions) == row["candidate_positions"]
        assert encoded.query_position == row["query_position"]
        logits = row["legacy_logits"]
        assert isinstance(logits, list)
        saved.append([float(cast(float, value)) for value in logits])
    exact = ExactWidth(
        scorer.backbone,
        scorer.head,
        scorer.encoder,
        model_id=scorer.model_id,
        device=scorer.device,
    )
    baseline = Microbatches(scorer, options.batch_size, sort=False)
    requests = tuple(case.request for case in cases)
    baseline_gate = quality(
        cases, saved, baseline.score_many(requests), scorer.model_id
    )
    assert baseline_gate.passed
    reports: dict[str, object] = {}
    for name, candidate in (
        ("exact", Microbatches(exact, options.batch_size, sort=False)),
        ("sorted", Microbatches(scorer, options.batch_size, sort=True)),
        ("sorted-exact", Microbatches(exact, options.batch_size, sort=True)),
    ):
        try:
            gate = quality(
                cases, saved, candidate.score_many(requests), scorer.model_id
            )
        except Exception as error:
            reports[name] = {
                "screen_error": f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
                "timed": False,
            }
            continue
        if not gate.passed:
            reports[name] = {"screen": asdict(gate), "timed": False}
            continue
        report = benchmark_pair(
            BenchmarkEngine(
                "caller-rounded8", Model(baseline, scorer.model_id), len(cases)
            ),
            BenchmarkEngine(name, Model(candidate, scorer.model_id), len(cases)),
            cases,
            protocol=BenchmarkProtocol(repeats=5, warmup=1),
        )
        reports[name] = report.to_dict()
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "arm": name,
                    "passed": report.passed,
                    "speed": report.to_dict()["speed"],
                }
            ),
            flush=True,
        )
    payload = {
        "scope": "77-case training-source runtime assay; ready-cohort scheduling only",
        "dataset_sha256": dataset_hash,
        "model_id": scorer.model_id,
        "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "backend_sha256": hashlib.sha256(

class PrefixScorer(ProductionPrefixScorer):
    """Pure prefix ablation: retain the maintained full cached final block."""

    def _logits(
        self,
        ids: mx.array,
        endpoints: mx.array,
        query_positions: mx.array,
        caches: list[PrefixCache],
    ) -> mx.array:
        hidden = self._forward(ids, caches)
        rows = mx.arange(ids.shape[0])
        return self.base.head(
            hidden[rows[:, None], endpoints], hidden[rows, query_positions]
        )


def study(
    output: Path,
    *,
    batch_size: int = 8,
    candidate_type: type[ProductionPrefixScorer] = PrefixScorer,
    strategy: Literal["prefix25", "prefix25-endpoints"] = "prefix25",
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """One frozen25-token resource; fixed512MiB allocator cap for both arms."""
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "completed": False,
        "passed": False,
        "performance_gate_passed": False,
        "strategy": strategy,
        "candidate_type": candidate_type.__qualname__,
        "started_wall_time_ns": time.time_ns(),
    }
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(payload) + "\n")
    try:
        if type(batch_size) is not int or batch_size < 1:
            raise ValueError("Batch size must be positive")
        if strategy not in ("prefix25", "prefix25-endpoints"):
            raise ValueError("Unknown experiment strategy")
        sources = freeze_sources(
            {
                name: root / name
                for name in (
                    "benchmarks/analysis/mlx/prefix.py",
                    "benchmarks/analysis/mlx/combined.py",
                    "benchmarks/analysis/mlx/endpoints.py",
                    "benchmarks/analysis/mlx/cache.py",
                    "benchmarks/analysis/mlx/profile.py",
                    "benchmarks/analysis/reference.py",
                    "benchmarks/analysis/evidence.py",
                    "wyat/backends/kai/mlx.py",
                    "wyat/backends/kai/prefix.py",
                    "wyat/backends/kai/readout.py",
                    "wyat/backends/kai/encoding.py",
                    "wyat/benchmark.py",
                    "wyat/core.py",
                    "wyat/evaluation.py",
                )
            }
            | {
                "maintained_cache": Path(inspect.getfile(KVCache)),
                "maintained_qwen3": Path(inspect.getfile(Qwen3Model)),
                "maintained_attention": Path(inspect.getfile(maintained_base)),
                "maintained_rope": Path(inspect.getfile(RoPE)),
                "candidate_strategy": Path(inspect.getfile(candidate_type)),
            },
            output,
        )
        payload.update(
            sources_sha256=sources.hashes(), sources_archive=sources.archive()
        )
        dataset = root / "benchmarks/real/banking77-train-dev-menu6.jsonl"
        dataset_bytes = dataset.read_bytes()
        dataset_hash = hashlib.sha256(dataset_bytes).hexdigest()
        if dataset_hash != DATASET_SHA256:
            raise ValueError("Frozen development cohort hash changed")
        cases = tuple(
            case_from_dict(decode_json(row))
            for row in dataset_bytes.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
        )
        if len(cases) != 77:
            raise ValueError("Experiment requires all77 frozen cases")
        reference_path = root / "benchmarks/real/torch-fp32-reference77.json"
        reference_hash = hashlib.sha256(reference_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        with bounded_cache(512 * 1024**2) as previous_cap:
            base = MLXKaiScorer.from_directory(
                root / ".models/Decision-2.0-Kai-0.6B",
                max_length=512,
                token_cache_size=0,
                device="gpu",
                compile=False,
            )
            reference = read_reference(
                reference_path, cases, base, dataset_sha256=dataset_hash
            )
            encoded = tuple(base.encode_request(case.request) for case in cases)
            prefix = encoded[0].ids[:25]
            before = memory()
            build_start = time.perf_counter_ns()
            candidate = candidate_type(base, prefix)
            mx.synchronize(base.device)
            build_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - build_start) / 1e6
            after = memory()
            if len(prefix) != 25 or not all(candidate._admits(row) for row in encoded):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Not every frozen case admits the declared25-token prefix"
                )
            baseline_engine = BenchmarkEngine(
                "full-prefill", Model(base, base.model_id), batch_size
            )
            candidate_engine = BenchmarkEngine(
                strategy, Model(candidate, base.model_id), batch_size
            )
            screens = (_run(baseline_engine, cases), _run(candidate_engine, cases))
            screen_gate = compare_cycles((reference,) * 2, screens, QualityGate())
            payload.update(
                scope=f"real full77 training-source {strategy} experiment",
                model_id=base.model_id,
                dataset_sha256=dataset_hash,
                reference_sha256=reference_hash,
                versions={
                    name: version(name) for name in ("mlx", "mlx-lm", "transformers")
                },
                device=mx.device_info(base.device),
                dtype="float32",
                compile=False,
                batch_size=batch_size,
                token_cache_size=0,
                cache_cap_bytes=512 * 1024**2,
                original_cache_cap_bytes=previous_cap,
                prefix_tokens=list(prefix),
                prefix_length=25,
                prefix_logical_state_bytes=candidate.prefix_state_bytes,
                prefix_build_ms=build_ms,
                memory_before_prefix_build=before,
                memory_after_prefix_build=after,
                token_lengths=[len(row.ids) for row in encoded],
                screen_cycles=[cycle.to_dict() for cycle in screens],
                screen_quality=asdict(screen_gate),
                hypothesis=(
                    "Exact prefix reuse preserves strict quality "
                    "and improves full cohort latency"
                    if strategy == "prefix25"
                    else "Combined prefix and endpoint reuse preserves strict "
                    "quality and improves full cohort latency; separate gains "
                    "are not multiplied"
                ),
                promotion_gate=(
                    "median>=1.02 and paired_p05>1 plus strict quality "
                    "and scalar confirmation"
                ),
                lifecycle=(
                    "immutable fixed-weight prefix states; fresh perbatch "
                    "KVCache owners; no cross-request suffix state"
                ),
                limits=[
                    "Prefix build excluded from warm/measured timing "
                    "and reported separately.",
                    "Prefix_state_bytes is logical; array views may retain "
                    "backing allocation.",
                    "One initial warm each; continuous512MiB allocator history, "
                    "no perarm clearing.",
                    "Any mismatch or overlapping readout falls back whole batch; "
                    "duplicate encoding is charged.",
                    "Original rounded fullwidth preserved; maintained causal "
                    "mask/RoPE offsets; true readouts translated once.",
                    "Same77 examples repeated; released-model exposure unknown, "
                    "no held-out quality claim.",
                    "Source snapshots attest setup-time disk bytes, "
                    "not imported/external execution.",
                ],
            )
            output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            if screen_gate.passed:
                report, telemetry = paired_with_telemetry(
                    baseline_engine,
                    candidate_engine,
                    cases,
                    incremental=output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl"),
                )
                cycles = (
                    report.baseline_warmup_cycles
                    + report.candidate_warmup_cycles
                    + report.baseline_cycles
                    + report.candidate_cycles
                )
                gate = compare_cycles((reference,) * len(cycles), cycles, QualityGate())
                speedups = tuple(
                    left.latency_ms / right.latency_ms
                    for left, right in zip(
                        report.baseline_cycles, report.candidate_cycles, strict=True
                    )
                )
                payload.update(
                    paired=report.to_dict(),
                    untimed_telemetry=telemetry,
                    all_cycles_cpu_quality=asdict(gate),
                    passed=report.passed and gate.passed,
                    performance_gate_passed=(
                        report.passed
                        and gate.passed
                        and percentile(speedups, 0.5) >= 1.02
                        and percentile(speedups, 0.05) > 1
                    ),
                )
            payload["completed"] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        payload.update(
            completed=False,
            passed=False,
            performance_gate_passed=False,
            error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
        )
        raise
    finally:
        output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    return payload

"""Bound the existing combined assay against final production source."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from argparse import ArgumentParser, Namespace
from pathlib import Path

from benchmarks.analysis.evidence import freeze_sources


def launch(python: Path, output: Path, *, batch_size: int) -> int:
    """Retain parent status; the shared study owns timing and quality policy."""
    if type(batch_size) is not int or batch_size not in (1, 8):
        raise ValueError("Production confirmation requires batch size 1 or 8")
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    output = output.resolve()
    wall = output.with_suffix(".wall.json")
    if output.exists() or wall.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve existing assay receipts; choose a new output")
    source = freeze_sources({"launcher": Path(__file__)}, wall)
    command = [
        str(python.absolute()),
        "-m",
        "benchmarks.analysis.mlx.combined",
        "--batch-size",
        str(batch_size),
        "--output",
        str(output),
    ]
    started = time.perf_counter()
    receipt: dict[str, object] = {
        "command": command,
        "started_wall_time_ns": time.time_ns(),
        "timeout_seconds": 180,
        "timed_out": False,
        "completed": False,
        "sources_sha256": source.hashes(),
        "sources_archive": source.archive(),
        "scope": "Parent process status; child study owns numerical/performance gates",
    }
    wall.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            command,
            cwd=root,
            env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": str(root)},
            check=False,
            timeout=180,
        )
        code = result.returncode
        receipt["completed"] = True
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        receipt["timed_out"] = True
        code = 124
    except OSError as error:
        receipt["error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
        code = 1
    receipt.update(
        process_exit_code=code,
        elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter() - started,
        finished_wall_time_ns=time.time_ns(),
    )
    wall.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
    return code


class Arguments(Namespace):
    batch_size: int
    python: Path
    output: Path | None


def main() -> None:
    parser = ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, choices=(1, 8), default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--python", type=Path, default=Path(sys.executable))
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    options = parser.parse_args(namespace=Arguments())
    output = options.output or Path(
        f"benchmarks/analysis/results/mlx-prefix-production77-b{options.batch_size}.json"
    )
    raise SystemExit(launch(options.python, output, batch_size=options.batch_size))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Synchronize real Kai stages; report diagnostic overhead and preserved outputs."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import time
from argparse import ArgumentParser
from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from functools import partial
from importlib.metadata import version
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median
from typing import Protocol, TypeVar, cast

import mlx.core as mx

from benchmarks.analysis.reference import read_reference
from benchmarks.analysis.scaling import amdahl_ceiling
from wyat.backends.kai.encoding import EncodedRequest
from wyat.backends.kai.mlx import MLXKaiScorer
from wyat.benchmark import BenchmarkCycle, DriftReport, QualityGate, compare_cycles
from wyat.core import decision_from_logits
from wyat.evaluation import EvaluationCase, EvaluationRow, case_from_dict
from wyat.wire import decode_json

T = TypeVar("T")


class ArrayMap(Protocol):
    def __call__(self, x: mx.array) -> mx.array: ...


class AttentionMap(Protocol):
    def __call__(self, x: mx.array, mask: str, cache: None = None) -> mx.array: ...


class Block(Protocol):
    input_layernorm: ArrayMap
    self_attn: AttentionMap
    post_attention_layernorm: ArrayMap
    mlp: ArrayMap


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class StageSample:
    repeat: int
    batch: int
    layer: int | None
    phase: str
    latency_ms: float


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PackedBatch:
    ids: mx.array
    endpoints: mx.array
    queries: mx.array
    encoded: tuple[EncodedRequest, ...]


class Recorder:
    def __init__(self, device: mx.Device, repeat: int, batch: int) -> None:
        self.device = device
        self.repeat = repeat
        self.batch = batch
        self.samples: list[StageSample] = []

    def cpu(self, phase: str, operation: Callable[[], T]) -> T:
        start = time.perf_counter_ns()
        result = operation()
        elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
        self.samples.append(StageSample(self.repeat, self.batch, None, phase, elapsed))
        return result

    def gpu(
        self, phase: str, operation: Callable[[], T], layer: int | None = None
    ) -> T:
        # Fences intentionally expose execution ownership. They change graph
        # scheduling and fusion opportunities, so these are diagnostic timings.
        mx.synchronize(self.device)
        start = time.perf_counter_ns()
        result = operation()
        mx.eval(result)
        mx.synchronize(self.device)
        elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
        self.samples.append(StageSample(self.repeat, self.batch, layer, phase, elapsed))
        return result


def pack(encoded: tuple[EncodedRequest, ...], pad_id: int) -> PackedBatch:
    length = -(-max(len(row.ids) for row in encoded) // 8) * 8
    width = max(len(row.candidate_positions) for row in encoded)
    ids = mx.array(
        [list(row.ids) + [pad_id] * (length - len(row.ids)) for row in encoded],
        dtype=mx.int32,
    )
    endpoints = mx.array(
        [
            list(row.candidate_positions) + [0] * (width - len(row.candidate_positions))
            for row in encoded
        ],
        dtype=mx.int32,
    )
    queries = mx.array([row.query_position for row in encoded], dtype=mx.int32)
    mx.eval(ids, endpoints, queries)
    return PackedBatch(ids, endpoints, queries, encoded)


def diagnostic_batch(
    scorer: MLXKaiScorer,
    cases: Sequence[EvaluationCase],
    repeat: int,
    batch: int,
) -> tuple[list[list[float]], list[StageSample], dict[str, object]]:
    recorder = Recorder(scorer.device, repeat, batch)
    encoded = recorder.cpu(
        "encoding", lambda: tuple(scorer.encode_request(case.request) for case in cases)
    )
    with mx.stream(scorer.device):
        # PackedBatch contains arrays inside a dataclass, so pack itself
        # evaluates them; the recorder's final fence still measures completion.
        packed = recorder.gpu("packing", lambda: pack(encoded, scorer.encoder.pad_id))
        hidden = recorder.gpu(
            "embedding", lambda: scorer.backbone.embed_tokens(packed.ids)
        )
        blocks = cast(Sequence[Block], scorer.backbone.layers)
        for index, block in enumerate(blocks):
            normalized = recorder.gpu(
                "input_norm", partial(block.input_layernorm, hidden), index
            )
            attention = recorder.gpu(
                "attention", partial(block.self_attn, normalized, "causal"), index
            )
            residual = recorder.gpu(
                "attention_residual", partial(mx.add, hidden, attention), index
            )
            normalized = recorder.gpu(
                "post_attention_norm",
                partial(block.post_attention_layernorm, residual),
                index,
            )
            output = recorder.gpu("mlp", partial(block.mlp, normalized), index)
            hidden = recorder.gpu(
                "mlp_residual", partial(mx.add, residual, output), index
            )
        norm = cast(ArrayMap, scorer.backbone.norm)
        hidden = recorder.gpu("final_norm", lambda: norm(hidden))
        rows = mx.arange(packed.ids.shape[0])
        candidates, query = recorder.gpu(
            "endpoint_gather",
            lambda: (
                hidden[rows[:, None], packed.endpoints],
                hidden[rows, packed.queries],
            ),
        )
        logits = recorder.gpu("head", lambda: scorer.head(candidates, query))
        values = recorder.cpu(
            "materialization", lambda: cast(list[list[float]], logits.tolist())
        )
    scores = [
        row[: len(item.candidate_positions)]
        for row, item in zip(values, encoded, strict=True)
    ]
    shape: dict[str, object] = {
        "batch": batch,
        "rows": len(cases),
        "padded_length": packed.ids.shape[1],
        "useful_tokens": sum(len(row.ids) for row in encoded),
        "padded_tokens": packed.ids.size,
        "candidate_counts": [len(row.candidate_positions) for row in encoded],
        "lengths": [len(row.ids) for row in encoded],
    }
    return scores, recorder.samples, shape


def quality_rows(
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
    logits: Sequence[Sequence[float]],
    model_id: str,
) -> tuple[EvaluationRow, ...]:
    rows: list[EvaluationRow] = []
    for case, values in zip(cases, logits, strict=True):
        prediction = decision_from_logits(case.request, values, model_id)
        rows.append(
            EvaluationRow(
                case.id,
                case.expected,
                "ok",
                prediction,
                prediction.selected in case.expected,
                0.0,
                None,
            )
        )
    return tuple(rows)


def quality(
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
    reference: Sequence[Sequence[float]],
    candidate: Sequence[Sequence[float]],
    model_id: str,
) -> DriftReport:
    return compare_cycles(
        [BenchmarkCycle(0.0, quality_rows(cases, reference, model_id), 0, 0)],
        [BenchmarkCycle(0.0, quality_rows(cases, candidate, model_id), 0, 0)],
        QualityGate(),
    )


def operand_bounds(
    scorer: MLXKaiScorer, batches: list[dict[str, object]]
) -> dict[str, object]:
    args = scorer.backbone.args
    hidden, intermediate = args.hidden_size, args.intermediate_size
    query = args.num_attention_heads * args.head_dim
    kv = args.num_key_value_heads * args.head_dim
    operations: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    total_flops = total_bytes = 0
    for shape in batches:
        batch, length = (
            int(cast(int, shape["rows"])),
            int(cast(int, shape["padded_length"])),
        )
        tokens = batch * length
        for name, inner, columns in (
            ("q_proj", hidden, query),
            ("k_proj", hidden, kv),
            ("v_proj", hidden, kv),
            ("o_proj", query, hidden),
            ("gate_proj", hidden, intermediate),
            ("up_proj", hidden, intermediate),
            ("down_proj", intermediate, hidden),
        ):
            flops = 2 * tokens * inner * columns
            operand_bytes = 4 * (tokens * inner + inner * columns + tokens * columns)
            operations.append(
                {
                    "batch": shape["batch"],
                    "operator": name,
                    "per_layer": True,
                    "input": [tokens, inner],
                    "weight": [columns, inner],
                    "output": [tokens, columns],
                    "flops": flops,
                    "operand_bytes_once": operand_bytes,
                    "arithmetic_intensity_flops_per_operand_byte": flops
                    / operand_bytes,
                }
            )
            total_flops += flops * args.num_hidden_layers
            total_bytes += operand_bytes * args.num_hidden_layers
        attention_dense = (
            4 * batch * args.num_attention_heads * length * length * args.head_dim
        )
        attention_causal = (
            2 * batch * args.num_attention_heads * length * (length + 1) * args.head_dim
        )
        attention_bytes = 4 * tokens * (2 * query + 2 * kv)
        operations.append(
            {
                "batch": shape["batch"],
                "operator": "fused_sdpa",
                "per_layer": True,
                "query": [batch, args.num_attention_heads, length, args.head_dim],
                "key_value": [batch, args.num_key_value_heads, length, args.head_dim],
                "dense_flops": attention_dense,
                "causal_useful_flops": attention_causal,
                "operand_bytes_once": attention_bytes,
                "score_matrix_materialized": False,
            }
        )
        total_flops += attention_dense * args.num_hidden_layers
        total_bytes += attention_bytes * args.num_hidden_layers
    return {
        "operators": operations,
        "dense_linear_plus_sdpa_flops": total_flops,
        "operand_bytes_once": total_bytes,
        "bytes_definition": (
            "Each operation reads input and weight once and writes output once; "
            "excludes inter-operation cache reuse; not measured DRAM traffic"
        ),
        "flops_exclude": ["norms", "RoPE", "softmax", "SiLU", "head", "packing"],
        "embedding": {
            "storage_bytes": args.vocab_size * hidden * 4,
            "lookup_does_not_read_entire_table": True,
        },
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--ordinary-repeats", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--profile-repeats", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--case-limit", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--trace-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    options = parser.parse_args()
    batch_size = int(options.batch_size)
    ordinary_repeats, profile_repeats = (
        int(options.ordinary_repeats),
        int(options.profile_repeats),
    )
    if min(batch_size, ordinary_repeats, profile_repeats) < 1:
        raise ValueError("batch size and repetitions must be positive")
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    dataset = root / "benchmarks/real/banking77-train-dev-menu6.jsonl"
    cases = tuple(
        case_from_dict(decode_json(line)) for line in dataset.read_text().splitlines()
    )
    dataset_hash = hashlib.sha256(dataset.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    scorer = MLXKaiScorer.from_directory(
        root / ".models/Decision-2.0-Kai-0.6B", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
    )
    frozen = read_reference(
        root / "benchmarks/real/torch-fp32-reference77.json",
        cases,
        scorer,
        dataset_sha256=dataset_hash,
    )
    reference: list[list[float]] = []
    for row in frozen.rows:
        if row.prediction is None:
            raise ValueError("Frozen reference must contain every prediction")
        reference.append(list(row.prediction.scores))
    case_limit = cast(int | None, options.case_limit)
    if case_limit is not None:
        if not 1 <= case_limit <= len(cases):
            raise ValueError("case limit must select an existing nonempty prefix")
        cases, reference = cases[:case_limit], reference[:case_limit]
    requests = tuple(case.request for case in cases)

    def ordinary() -> list[list[float]]:
        result: list[list[float]] = []
        for offset in range(0, len(requests), batch_size):
            result.extend(scorer.score_many(requests[offset : offset + batch_size]))
        return result

    def diagnostic(
        repeat: int,
    ) -> tuple[list[list[float]], list[StageSample], list[dict[str, object]]]:
        result: list[list[float]] = []
        samples: list[StageSample] = []
        shapes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        for offset in range(0, len(cases), batch_size):
            values, stages, shape = diagnostic_batch(
                scorer,
                cases[offset : offset + batch_size],
                repeat,
                offset // batch_size,
            )
            result.extend(values)
            samples.extend(stages)
            shapes.append(shape)
        return result, samples, shapes

    warmup = ordinary()
    assert quality(cases, reference, warmup, scorer.model_id).passed
    if bool(options.trace_only):
        # This branch supplies a short owned process to Xcode Instruments.
        # Its timings include trace instrumentation and are not a speed claim.
        cycles: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        for repeat in range(ordinary_repeats):
            start = time.perf_counter_ns()
            scores = ordinary()
            elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
            cycles.append(
                {
                    "repeat": repeat,
                    "latency_ms": elapsed,
                    "quality": asdict(
                        quality(cases, reference, scores, scorer.model_id)
                    ),
                    "logits": scores,
                }
            )
        payload: dict[str, object] = {
            "scope": "Owned short Metal trace workload; no performance claim",
            "model_id": scorer.model_id,
            "dataset_sha256": dataset_hash,
            "case_ids": [case.id for case in cases],
            "batch_size": batch_size,
            "cycles": cycles,
        }
        output = cast(Path | None, options.output)
        if output is not None:
            output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
        print(
            json.dumps({"trace_cycles": len(cycles), "output": str(output)}), flush=True
        )
        return
    diagnostic(-1)
    ordinary_cycles: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    diagnostic_cycles: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    all_stages: list[StageSample] = []
    shapes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for repeat in range(max(ordinary_repeats, profile_repeats)):

        def run_ordinary(repeat: int = repeat) -> None:
            mx.synchronize(scorer.device)
            start = time.perf_counter_ns()
            scores = ordinary()
            elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
            drift = quality(cases, reference, scores, scorer.model_id)
            ordinary_cycles.append(
                {
                    "repeat": repeat,
                    "latency_ms": elapsed,
                    "quality": asdict(drift),
                    "passed": drift.passed,
                    "logits": scores,
                }
            )

        def run_diagnostic(repeat: int = repeat) -> None:
            mx.synchronize(scorer.device)
            start = time.perf_counter_ns()
            scores, stages, batch_shapes = diagnostic(repeat)
            elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
            drift = quality(cases, reference, scores, scorer.model_id)
            diagnostic_cycles.append(
                {
                    "repeat": repeat,
                    "latency_ms": elapsed,
                    "quality": asdict(drift),
                    "passed": drift.passed,
                    "logits": scores,
                }
            )
            all_stages.extend(stages)
            shapes[:] = batch_shapes

        operations = []
        if repeat < ordinary_repeats:
            operations.append(run_ordinary)
        if repeat < profile_repeats:
            operations.append(run_diagnostic)
        if repeat % 2:
            operations.reverse()
        for operation in operations:
            operation()
    groups: dict[str, list[float]] = {}
    for repeat in range(profile_repeats):
        for stage in (
            "encoding",
            "packing",
            "embedding",
            "input_norm",
            "attention",
            "attention_residual",
            "post_attention_norm",
            "mlp",
            "mlp_residual",
            "final_norm",
            "endpoint_gather",
            "head",
            "materialization",
        ):
            groups.setdefault(stage, []).append(
                sum(
                    sample.latency_ms
                    for sample in all_stages
                    if sample.repeat == repeat and sample.phase == stage
                )
            )
    total_stage_median = sum(median(values) for values in groups.values())
    phases = {
        phase: {
            "cycle_totals_ms": values,
            "median_ms": median(values),
            "diagnostic_fraction": median(values) / total_stage_median,
            "conditional_amdahl_ceiling": amdahl_ceiling(
                median(values) / total_stage_median
            ),
        }
        for phase, values in groups.items()
    }
    ordinary_ms = [float(cast(float, cycle["latency_ms"])) for cycle in ordinary_cycles]
    diagnostic_ms = [
        float(cast(float, cycle["latency_ms"])) for cycle in diagnostic_cycles
    ]
    work = operand_bounds(scorer, shapes)
    payload = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "model_id": scorer.model_id,
        "dataset_sha256": dataset_hash,
        "scope": (
            f"{len(cases)} real BANKING77 development requests; "
            "no claimed unseen model-quality evaluation"
        ),
        "versions": {"mlx": version("mlx"), "mlx_lm": version("mlx-lm")},
        "device": mx.device_info(scorer.device),
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "token_cache_size": 0,
        "dtype": "float32",
        "quality_gate": asdict(QualityGate()),
        "tokens_and_endpoints_match_reference": True,
        "case_ids": [case.id for case in cases],
        "source_sha256": {
            str(path.relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for path in (
                Path(__file__),
                root / "wyat/backends/kai/mlx.py",
                root / "wyat/backends/kai/encoding.py",
                root / "wyat/benchmark.py",
                root / "benchmarks/analysis/reference.py",
            )
        },
        "passed": all(
            cycle["passed"] is True for cycle in ordinary_cycles + diagnostic_cycles
        ),
        "warmup": "one complete ordinary cohort and one diagnostic cohort",
        "ordinary_cycles": ordinary_cycles,
        "diagnostic_cycles": diagnostic_cycles,
        "ordinary_latency_median_ms": median(ordinary_ms),
        "diagnostic_latency_median_ms": median(diagnostic_ms),
        "instrumentation_ratio": median(diagnostic_ms) / median(ordinary_ms),
        "stage_fraction_denominator_ms": total_stage_median,
        "stage_fraction_denominator": "sum of per-phase cycle-total medians",
        "outer_overhead_median_difference_ms": (
            median(diagnostic_ms) - total_stage_median
        ),
        "phases": phases,
        "raw_stage_samples": [asdict(sample) for sample in all_stages],
        "batch_shapes": shapes,
        "work": work,
        "derived_dense_flops_per_second": cast(
            int, work["dense_linear_plus_sdpa_flops"]
        )
        / (median(ordinary_ms) / 1000),
        "metal_active_memory_bytes": mx.get_active_memory(),
        "metal_peak_memory_bytes": mx.get_peak_memory(),
        "limitations": [
            "Per-stage fences alter graph scheduling and fusion; "
            "Amdahl fractions are diagnostic conditional bounds",
            "Operand bytes are algorithmic bounds; "
            "external memory bandwidth was not measured",
            "One model and frozen cohort; "
            "deployment traffic behavior is not established",
        ],
    }
    output = (
        cast(Path | None, options.output)
        or root / "benchmarks/analysis/results/mlx-profile77-b8.json"
    )
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "output": str(output),
                "ordinary_median_ms": median(ordinary_ms),
                "diagnostic_median_ms": median(diagnostic_ms),
                "phases": phases,
            }
        ),
        flush=True,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

PINNED = {

    AUDIT: "9099425df4676a02b514ef821181c7b45d40e530c54eb80f44b4109454c4ab26",
    CHECKS: "966ba6a37aa30faa933a73b51a79d6da763a27cbb499ee1b5a5b9716bc578844",
}


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Context:
    original: Admission
    prior: JsonObject
    cold: Path
    sources: dict[str, Path]


def context(model: Path) -> Context:
    for path, expected in PINNED.items():
        if digest(path) != expected:
            raise ValueError("Frozen64 evidence changed")
    prior, audit, checks = map(read_object, PINNED)
    if (
        prior["completed"] is not True
        or prior["projection_quality_passed"] is not True
        or audit["audit_passed"] is not True
        or checks["completed"] is not True
    ):
        raise ValueError("Frozen64 evidence is incomplete")
    sources = archive(
        checks["source_archive"], object_value(checks["source_sha256"]), 111
    )
    hashes = object_value(prior["source_hashes"])
    exact_sources = archive(prior["source_archive"], hashes, 123)
    if any(digest(path) != hashes[name] for name, path in exact_sources.items()):
        raise ValueError("Frozen64 source bytes changed")
    sources.update(exact_sources)
    for record in object_value(audit["artifacts"]).values():
        checked_file(record)
    original = admit(model)
    if checked_file(prior["reused_inputs"]) != original.inputs:
        raise ValueError("Frozen64 trial used different captured inputs")
    return Context(original, prior, checked_file(prior["cold_outputs"]), sources)

"""Verify frozen reference inputs without importing a tensor backend."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Protocol, cast

from wyat.backends.kai.encoding import EncodedRequest
from wyat.benchmark import BenchmarkCycle
from wyat.core import Request, decision_from_logits
from wyat.evaluation import EvaluationCase, EvaluationRow
from wyat.wire import read_object


class ReferenceEncoder(Protocol):
    model_id: str

    def encode_request(self, request: Request) -> EncodedRequest: ...


def balanced_orders(loads: Sequence[int], repeats: int) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]:
    """Rotate distinct loads so each occupies every measurement position equally."""
    values = tuple(loads)
    if (
        not values
        or any(type(value) is not int or value < 1 for value in values)
        or len(set(values)) != len(values)
        or type(repeats) is not int
        or repeats < len(values)
        or repeats % len(values)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Use unique positive loads and balanced repetition count")
    return tuple(
        values[offset:] + values[:offset]
        for repeat in range(repeats)
        for offset in (repeat % len(values),)
    )


def read_reference(
    path: Path,
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
    encoder: ReferenceEncoder,
    *,
    dataset_sha256: str,
) -> BenchmarkCycle:
    document = read_object(path)
    raw = document["rows"]
    if not isinstance(raw, list) or len(raw) != len(cases):
        raise ValueError("Reference must contain every declared case")
    if document["model_id"] != encoder.model_id:
        raise ValueError("Loaded model identity differs from frozen CPU reference")
    if document["dataset_sha256"] != dataset_sha256:
        raise ValueError("Reference dataset hash differs from declared cohort")
    rows: list[EvaluationRow] = []
    for case, item in zip(cases, raw, strict=True):
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("Reference row must be an object")
        encoded = encoder.encode_request(case.request)
        if (
            item["id"] != case.id
            or item["candidate_ids"]
            != [candidate.id for candidate in case.request.candidates]
            or item["token_ids"] != list(encoded.ids)
            or item["candidate_positions"] != list(encoded.candidate_positions)
            or item["query_position"] != encoded.query_position
        ):
            raise ValueError(f"Reference inputs differ for {case.id}")
        saved = item["legacy_logits"]
        if not isinstance(saved, list) or any(
            type(value) not in (int, float) for value in saved
        ):
            raise ValueError("Reference logits must be numbers")
        prediction = decision_from_logits(
            case.request,
            tuple(float(cast(float, value)) for value in saved),
            encoder.model_id,
        )
        rows.append(
            EvaluationRow(
                case.id,
                case.expected,
                "ok",
                prediction,
                prediction.selected in case.expected,
                0,
                None,
            )
        )
    return BenchmarkCycle(0, tuple(rows), 0, 0)

from __future__ import annotations

BATCH_SIZES = (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32)
DATASET_SHA256 = "0020d9a3c72a21941ba551cf31f404187f69c6a5dc30299cc0a24d303b904a03"


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _shape(model_path: Path) -> TransformerShape:
    config = read_object(model_path / "backbone/config.json")
    keys = (
        "hidden_size",
        "intermediate_size",
        "num_hidden_layers",
        "num_attention_heads",
        "num_key_value_heads",
        "head_dim",
    )
    values = tuple(config[key] for key in keys)
    if any(type(value) is not int for value in values):
        raise ValueError("Transformer dimensions must be declared integers")
    return TransformerShape(*(cast(int, value) for value in values))


def _work(
    lengths: Sequence[int], shape: TransformerShape, batch_size: int
) -> dict[str, object]:
    batches = tuple(
        estimate_batch_work(lengths[start : start + batch_size], shape)
        for start in range(0, len(lengths), batch_size)
    )
    useful = sum(batch.useful_tokens for batch in batches)
    padded = sum(batch.padded_tokens for batch in batches)
    return {
        "batches": [asdict(batch) for batch in batches],
        "useful_tokens": useful,
        "padded_tokens": padded,
        "padding_fraction": 1 - useful / padded,
        "projection_flops": sum(batch.projection_flops for batch in batches),
        "dense_attention_flops": sum(batch.dense_attention_flops for batch in batches),
        "ideal_causal_attention_flops": sum(
            batch.ideal_causal_attention_flops for batch in batches
        ),
    }


def sweep(model_path: Path, output: Path, *, repeats: int = 6) -> dict[str, object]:
    if type(repeats) is not int or repeats < 6 or repeats % 6:
        raise ValueError(
            "Use a positive multiple of six repetitions for balanced order"
        )
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    dataset = root / "benchmarks/real/banking77-train-dev-menu6.jsonl"
    reference_path = root / "benchmarks/real/torch-fp32-reference77.json"
    if digest(dataset) != DATASET_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("Declared real development cohort hash changed")
    cases = tuple(
        case_from_dict(decode_json(line)) for line in dataset.read_text().splitlines()
    )
    if len(cases) != 77:
        raise ValueError("Scaling experiment requires the complete 77-case cohort")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    scorer = MLXKaiScorer.from_directory(
        model_path, max_length=512, token_cache_size=0, device="gpu", compile=False
    )
    reference = read_reference(
        reference_path, cases, scorer, dataset_sha256=DATASET_SHA256
    )
    model = Model(scorer, scorer.model_id)
    lengths = tuple(len(scorer.encode_request(case.request).ids) for case in cases)
    shape = _shape(model_path)
    gate = QualityGate()
    engines = {
        size: BenchmarkEngine(f"mlx-fp32-batch{size}", model, size)
        for size in BATCH_SIZES
    }
    warmup = {size: _run(engine, cases) for size, engine in engines.items()}
    measured: dict[int, list[BenchmarkCycle]] = {size: [] for size in BATCH_SIZES}
    journal = output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl")
    orders = balanced_orders(BATCH_SIZES, repeats)
    with journal.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        for repeat, order in enumerate(orders):
            for size in order:
                cycle = _run(engines[size], cases)
                measured[size].append(cycle)
                stream.write(
                    json.dumps(
                        {
                            "repeat": repeat,
                            "batch_size": size,
                            "cycle": cycle.to_dict(),
                        },
                        allow_nan=False,
                    )
                    + "\n"
                )
                stream.flush()
            print(
                json.dumps(
                    {"completed_round": repeat + 1, "rounds": repeats, "order": order}
                ),
                flush=True,
            )
    sizes: dict[str, object] = {}
    points: list[ScalingPoint] = []
    for size in BATCH_SIZES:
        cycles = tuple(measured[size])
        quality = compare_cycles((reference,) * repeats, cycles, gate)
        seconds = math.fsum(cycle.latency_ms for cycle in cycles) / 1000
        attempted = len(cases) * repeats
        failed = sum(cycle.failed for cycle in cycles)
        successful = attempted - failed
        timings = [cycle.latency_ms for cycle in cycles]
        residence = [row.latency_ms for cycle in cycles for row in cycle.rows]
        successful_rps = successful / seconds
        warmup_quality = compare_cycles((reference,), (warmup[size],), gate)
        passed = quality.passed and warmup_quality.passed
        if passed:
            points.append(ScalingPoint(size, successful_rps))
        sizes[str(size)] = {
            "quality": asdict(quality),
            "warmup_quality": asdict(warmup_quality),
            "passed": passed,
            "attempted": attempted,
            "failed": failed,
            "successful_requests_per_second": successful_rps,
            "equivalent_requests_per_second": successful_rps if passed else 0,
            "labeled_correct_requests_per_second": sum(
                cycle.correct for cycle in cycles
            )
            / seconds,
            "cycle_p50_ms": percentile(timings, 0.5),
            "cycle_p95_ms": percentile(timings, 0.95),
            "batch_residence_p50_ms": percentile(residence, 0.5),
            "batch_residence_p95_ms": percentile(residence, 0.95),
            "measured_cycles": [cycle.to_dict() for cycle in cycles],
            "warmup_cycle": warmup[size].to_dict(),
            "work": _work(lengths, shape, size),
        }
    fit = asdict(fit_usl(points)) if len(points) == 6 else None
    result: dict[str, object] = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "scope": "real fixed-cohort FP32 engine scaling experiment",
        "model_id": scorer.model_id,
        "dataset_sha256": DATASET_SHA256,
        "reference_sha256": digest(reference_path),
        "input_sha256": _input_digest(cases),
        "case_ids": [case.id for case in cases],
        "token_lengths": list(lengths),
        "token_length_summary": {
            "min": min(lengths),
            "max": max(lengths),
            "mean": math.fsum(lengths) / len(lengths),
        },
        "shape": asdict(shape),
        "environment": {
            "python": platform.python_version(),
            "platform": platform.platform(),
            "mlx": version("mlx"),
            "mlx_lm": version("mlx-lm"),
            "device": "gpu",
            "dtype": "float32",
            "compile": False,
            "token_cache_size": 0,
        },
        "protocol": {
            "batch_sizes": BATCH_SIZES,
            "repeats": repeats,
            "warmup_per_size": 1,
            "orders": orders,
            "quality_gate": asdict(gate),
            "cohort_order": "unchanged canonical caller order",
            "timing": "complete cycles; native host-float synchronization; "
            "model/packing/tokenization/decision bookkeeping",
            "excludes": ["loading", "warmup", "JSON serialization", "HTTP"],
        },
        "sizes": sizes,
        "usl_descriptive_batch_fit": fit,
        "roofline": {
            "status": "unknown",
            "reason": "No independent sustained compute/DRAM ceiling and actual "
            "traffic measurements supplied.",
        },
        "source_sha256": {
            "runner": digest(Path(__file__)),
            "scaling": digest(root / "benchmarks/analysis/scaling.py"),
            "reference": digest(root / "benchmarks/analysis/reference.py"),
            "mlx_backend": digest(root / "wyat/backends/kai/mlx.py"),
        },
        "limits": [

            "cache coherence.",
            "Same 77 labeled development cases repeated; no held-out quality claim.",
            "Arithmetic excludes norms/RoPE/softmax/activation/head; causal "
            "flash schedule is unknown.",
            "Process peak RSS is shared cumulative high-water, not isolated "
            "per-shape device memory.",

    }
    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    return result
