                "sdpa": Path(sdpa_attention.__file__),
            },
            output,
        )
        cases = tuple(
            case_from_dict(decode_json(line))
            for line in (ROOT / "benchmarks/real/banking77-train-dev-menu6.jsonl")
            .read_text()
            .splitlines()
        )
        flags = {
            name: vars(sdpa_attention)[name]
            for name in (
                "_is_torch_mps_available",
                "_is_torch_greater_or_equal_than_2_13",
            )
        }
        payload.update(
            source_sha256=sources.hashes(),
            source_archive=sources.archive(),
            sdpa_flags=flags,
            torch_mps_built=torch.backends.mps.is_built(),
            torch_mps_available=torch.backends.mps.is_available(),
            torch_build=torch.__config__.show(),
            input_sha256=_input_digest(cases),
            case_ids=[case.id for case in cases],
            interop_threads=torch.get_num_interop_threads(),
        )
        if not all(value is True for value in flags.values()):
            raise ValueError("Native masked-GQA flags differ from admitted screen")
        torch.set_num_threads(8)
        payload["phase"] = "loading"
        write()
        base = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model, device="cpu", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
        )
        if base.model_id != history["model_id"]:
            raise ValueError("Model identity differs from admitted first-eight screen")
        reference = read_reference(
            ROOT / "benchmarks/real/torch-fp32-reference77.json",
            cases,
            base,
            dataset_sha256=DATASET_SHA256,
        )
        encoded = tuple(base.encode_request(case.request) for case in cases)
        prefix = tuple(cast(list[int], history["prefix_tokens"]))
        before = process_diagnostic()
        started = time.perf_counter_ns()
        candidate = PrefixScorer(base, prefix)
        build_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
        if len(prefix) != 25 or not all(candidate.admits(row) for row in encoded):
            raise ValueError(
                "Not every frozen full77 case admits original25-token prefix"
            )
        payload.update(
            model_id=base.model_id,
            dataset_sha256=history["dataset_sha256"],
            reference_sha256=history["reference_sha256"],
            prefix_tokens=list(prefix),
            prefix_build_ms=build_ms,
            prefix_state_bytes=candidate.prefix_state_bytes,
            token_lengths=[len(row.ids) for row in encoded],
            phase="cycles",
        )
        engines = (
            BenchmarkEngine("cpu-full-prefill", Model(base, base.model_id), batch_size),
            BenchmarkEngine(
                "cpu-exact-prefix25", Model(candidate, base.model_id), batch_size
            ),
        )
        measured: tuple[list[BenchmarkCycle], list[BenchmarkCycle]] = ([], [])
        with output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl").open("w") as journal:

            def run(index: int, stage: str, repeat: int) -> BenchmarkCycle:
                diagnostic = process_diagnostic()
                cycle = _run(engines[index], cases)
                quality = compare_cycles((reference,), (cycle,), gate)
                row: dict[str, object] = {
                    "arm": engines[index].name,
                    "stage": stage,
                    "repeat": repeat,
                    "cycle": cycle.to_dict(),
                    "reference_quality": asdict(quality),
                    "before": asdict(diagnostic),
                    "after": asdict(process_diagnostic()),
                }
                rows.append(row)
                payload["cycles"] = rows
                journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                journal.flush()
                write()
                return cycle

            screens = (run(0, "screen", 0), run(1, "screen", 0))
            if not compare_cycles((reference,) * 2, screens, gate).passed:
                payload.update(completed=True, phase="rejected screen")
                write()
                return False
            warmup = (run(0, "warmup", 0), run(1, "warmup", 0))
            for repeat in range(plan.repeats):
                for index in (0, 1) if repeat % 2 == 0 else (1, 0):
                    measured[index].append(run(index, "measured", repeat))
        cycles = screens + warmup + tuple(measured[0]) + tuple(measured[1])
        reference_quality = compare_cycles((reference,) * len(cycles), cycles, gate)
        report = BenchmarkReport(
            _input_digest(cases),
            cases,
            plan,
            *engines,
            tuple(measured[0]),
            tuple(measured[1]),
            compare_cycles(*measured, gate),
            (warmup[0],),
            (warmup[1],),
        )
        ratios = [
            left.latency_ms / right.latency_ms
            for left, right in zip(*measured, strict=True)
        ]
        left_times = [cycle.latency_ms for cycle in measured[0]]
        right_times = [cycle.latency_ms for cycle in measured[1]]
        observed = {
            "paired_median": percentile(ratios, 0.5),
            "paired_p05": percentile(ratios, 0.05),
            "aggregate_throughput_ratio": sum(left_times) / sum(right_times),
            "candidate_cohort_p95_ratio": percentile(right_times, 0.95)
            / percentile(left_times, 0.95),
        }
        performance = (
            observed["paired_median"] >= 1.02
            and observed["paired_p05"] > 1
            and observed["aggregate_throughput_ratio"] > 1
            and observed["candidate_cohort_p95_ratio"] <= 1
        )
        quality_passed = report.passed and reference_quality.passed
        payload.update(
            report=report.to_dict(),
            reference_quality=asdict(reference_quality),
            quality_passed=quality_passed,
            performance_passed=performance,
            performance_observed=observed,
            accepted=performance and quality_passed,
            completed=True,
            phase="complete",
            diagnostics={
                "period": "prefix build plus all screen/warm/measured cycles",
                "before": asdict(before),
                "after": asdict(process_diagnostic()),
            },
        )
        write()
        return quality_passed
    except BaseException as error:
        payload.update(
            completed=False,
            quality_passed=False,
            performance_passed=False,
            accepted=False,
            phase="failed",
            error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
        )
        write()
        raise
    finally:
        torch.set_num_threads(previous_threads)

"""Launch the native CPU prefix dispatch screen under an owned 180-second cap.

python -m benchmarks.analysis.torch.prefix.run MODEL --output RECEIPT.json
Run in the released native Mac context; no flag patching or compilation.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from argparse import ArgumentParser, Namespace
from pathlib import Path

from benchmarks.analysis.torch.process import launch

from .study import ROOT, study


class Arguments(Namespace):
    model: Path
    output: Path | None
    worker: bool
    batch_size: int
    pairs: bool


def main() -> None:
    parser = ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--pairs", action="store_true", help="full77 confirmation")
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, choices=(1, 8), default=8)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
    )
    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true", help="internal owned process")
    args = parser.parse_args(namespace=Arguments())
    if not args.pairs and args.batch_size != 8:
        parser.error("first-eight dispatch screen requires batch size8")
    output = args.output or ROOT / (
        f"benchmarks/analysis/results/torch-prefix77-b{args.batch_size}.json"
        if args.pairs
        else "benchmarks/analysis/results/torch-prefix8.json"
    )
    model, output = ROOT / args.model, ROOT / output
    if args.worker:
        if args.pairs:
            from .pairs import study as confirm

            passed = confirm(model, output, batch_size=args.batch_size)
        else:
            passed = study(model, output)
        raise SystemExit(0 if passed else 1)
    worker_args = (
        ("--pairs", "--batch-size", str(args.batch_size)) if args.pairs else ()
    )
    raise SystemExit(
        launch(
            __package__ + ".run", model, output, timeout=180, worker_args=worker_args
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""A hard wall cap for an experiment and only its owned process group."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path


def launch(
    module: str,
    model: Path,
    output: Path,
    *,
    timeout: float,
    worker_args: tuple[str, ...] = (),
) -> int:
    if not math.isfinite(timeout) or timeout <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Timeout must be finite and positive")
    output = output.resolve()
    if any(output.parent.glob(output.stem + ".*")):
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve existing receipts; choose a new output")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    command = [
        sys.executable,
        "-m",
        module,
        str(model),
        "--output",
        str(output),
        *worker_args,
        "--worker",
    ]
    environment = {**os.environ}
    if module.endswith("autotune"):
        environment.update(
            TORCHINDUCTOR_FREEZING="1",
            TORCH_LOGS="output_code",
            TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS="1",
        )
        environment["TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR"] = tempfile.mkdtemp(
            prefix="wyat-cpu-autotune-", dir="/private/tmp"
        )
    started = time.perf_counter()
    status: dict[str, object] = {
        "command": command,
        "timeout_seconds": timeout,
        "completed": False,
        "timed_out": False,
        "inductor_cache": environment.get("TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR"),
    }
    wall = output.with_suffix(".wall.json")
    wall.write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2) + "\n")
    code = 1
    with output.with_suffix(".log").open("w") as log:
        child = subprocess.Popen(
            command, env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=log, start_new_session=True
        )
        try:
            code = child.wait(timeout=timeout)
            status["completed"] = code == 0
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            status["timed_out"] = True
            code = 124
        finally:
            # Workers inherit this new session; never signal another experiment.
            try:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            child.wait()
    status.update(exit_code=code, elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter() - started)
    wall.write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    return code

from wyat.backends.kai.torch import KaiScorer
from wyat.benchmark import (
    BenchmarkCycle,
    BenchmarkEngine,
    QualityGate,
    _run,
    compare_cycles,
)
from wyat.evaluation import _input_digest, case_from_dict

from ..evidence import freeze_sources, process_diagnostic
from ..reference import read_reference

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
DATASET_SHA256 = "0020d9a3c72a21941ba551cf31f404187f69c6a5dc30299cc0a24d303b904a03"


class Arguments(argparse.Namespace):
    model: Path
    output: Path
    worker: bool


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def inspect(model_path: Path, output: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    from wyat.wire import decode_json

    dataset = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/banking77-train-dev-menu6.jsonl"
    reference_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/torch-fp32-reference77.json"
    gate = QualityGate(logit_atol=1e-3, logit_rtol=1e-3, probability_atol=1e-4)
    sources = freeze_sources(
        {
            "runner": Path(__file__),
            "reference": ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/reference.py",
            "evidence": ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/evidence.py",
            "backend": ROOT / "wyat/backends/kai/torch.py",
            "encoding": ROOT / "wyat/backends/kai/encoding.py",
            "artifact": ROOT / "wyat/backends/kai/artifact.py",
            "core": ROOT / "wyat/core.py",
            "benchmark": ROOT / "wyat/benchmark.py",
            "sdpa_integration": Path(sdpa_attention.__file__),
            "qwen3": Path(modeling_qwen3.__file__),
            "cpu_sdpa_guards": Path(torch.__file__).parent
            / "include/ATen/native/transformers/sdp_utils_cpp.h",
        },
        output,
    )
    reference_hash = digest(reference_path)
    if digest(dataset) != DATASET_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("Frozen development dataset changed")
    all_cases = tuple(
        case_from_dict(decode_json(line)) for line in dataset.read_text().splitlines()
    )
    if len(all_cases) != 77:
        raise ValueError("Expected the fixed 77-case development cohort")
    cases = all_cases[:8]
    prior_threads = torch.get_num_threads()
    torch.set_num_threads(8)
    try:
        scorer = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model_path, device="cpu", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
        )
        saved = read_reference(
            reference_path, all_cases, scorer, dataset_sha256=DATASET_SHA256
        )
        reference = BenchmarkCycle(0.0, saved.rows[:8], 0, 0)
        engine = BenchmarkEngine(
            "CPU FP32 SDPA profile", Model(scorer, scorer.model_id), 8
        )
        cycles: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl").open("w") as stream:
            for stage in ("warmup", "ordinary", "ordinary", "profile", "profile"):
                before = process_diagnostic()
                events: list[dict[str, object]] = []
                outer_start = time.perf_counter_ns()
                if stage == "profile":
                    with torch.profiler.profile(
                        activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU],
                        record_shapes=True,
                        with_stack=False,
                        profile_memory=False,
                    ) as profiler:
                        cycle = _run(engine, cases)
                    outer_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - outer_start) / 1e6
                    averages = cast(
                        Sequence[FunctionEventAvg],
                        profiler.key_averages(group_by_input_shape=True),
                    )
                    events = [
                        {
                            "operator": event.key,
                            "count": event.count,
                            "input_shapes": event.input_shapes,
                            "self_cpu_time_us": float(event.self_cpu_time_total),
                        }
                        for event in averages
                    ]
                else:
                    cycle = _run(engine, cases)
                    outer_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - outer_start) / 1e6
                after = process_diagnostic()
                quality = compare_cycles((reference,), (cycle,), gate)
                row: dict[str, object] = {
                    "stage": stage,
                    "cycle": cycle.to_dict(),
                    "quality": asdict(quality),
                    "passed": quality.passed,
                    "outer_wall_ms": outer_ms,
                    "before": asdict(before),
                    "after": asdict(after),
                    "operator_self_times": events,
                    "self_cpu_sum_us": math.fsum(
                        cast(float, event["self_cpu_time_us"]) for event in events
                    ),
                }
                cycles.append(row)
                stream.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                stream.flush()
        ordinary_ms = [
            cast(float, cast(dict[str, object], row["cycle"])["latency_ms"])
            for row in cycles
            if row["stage"] == "ordinary"
        ]
        profile_ms = [
            cast(float, cast(dict[str, object], row["cycle"])["latency_ms"])
            for row in cycles
            if row["stage"] == "profile"
        ]
        result: dict[str, object] = {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "scope": "first eight fixed BANKING77 cases; CPU dispatch diagnostic",
            "passed": all(row["passed"] is True for row in cycles),
            "model_id": scorer.model_id,
            "dataset_sha256": DATASET_SHA256,
            "reference_sha256": reference_hash,
            "input_sha256": _input_digest(cases),
            "case_ids": [case.id for case in cases],
            "token_lengths": [
                len(scorer.encode_request(case.request).ids) for case in cases
            ],
            "versions": {
                "torch": version("torch"),
                "transformers": version("transformers"),
            },
            "torch_git_version": torch.version.git_version,
            "source_sha256": sources.hashes(),
            "source_archive": sources.archive(),
            "protocol": {
                "dtype": "float32",
                "batch_size": 8,
                "intraop_threads": 8,
                "interop_threads": torch.get_num_interop_threads(),
                "max_length": 512,
                "token_cache_size": 0,
                "warmup": 1,
                "ordinary": 2,
                "profile": 2,
                "profiler": "CPU activity, shapes; no stacks or memory",
                "quality_gate": asdict(gate),
                "times": "operator SELF time only; no inclusive-time summation",
            },
            "sdpa_flags": {
                key: vars(sdpa_attention)[key]
                for key in (
                    "_is_torch_mps_available",
                    "_is_torch_greater_or_equal_than_2_13",
                )
            },
            "ordinary_median_ms": statistics.median(ordinary_ms),
            "profiled_call_median_ms": statistics.median(profile_ms),
            "instrumentation_ratio": statistics.median(profile_ms)
            / statistics.median(ordinary_ms),
            "cycles": cycles,
            "limits": [
                "Profiles alter execution and retain shapes; fractions are diagnostic.",
                "ATen self time does not expose Accelerate topology or DRAM traffic.",
                "Source eligibility is not observed dispatch; inspect events.",
                "No production change, alternate attention or unseen quality claim.",
            ],
        }
        output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        return result
    finally:
        torch.set_num_threads(prior_threads)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output",
        type=Path,
        default=ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/torch-profile8.json",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    args = parser.parse_args(namespace=Arguments())
    args.model, args.output = ROOT / args.model, ROOT / args.output
    if args.worker:
        result = inspect(args.model, args.output)
        if not result["passed"]:
            sys.exit(1)
        return
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    timed_out = False
    with args.output.with_suffix(".log").open("w") as log:
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            [
                sys.executable,
                "-m",
                "benchmarks.analysis.torch.profile",
                str(args.model),
                "--output",
                str(args.output),
                "--worker",
            ],
            cwd=ROOT,
            stdout=log,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            start_new_session=True,
        )
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=180)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timed_out = True
            try:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            process.wait()
    args.output.with_suffix(".wall.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "seconds": time.perf_counter() - start,
                "budget_seconds": 180,
                "timed_out": timed_out,
                "exit_code": process.returncode,
            },
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n"
    )
    if timed_out or process.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Bounded six-count CPU FP32 thread sweep; run after the Metal handoff.

python -m benchmarks.analysis.torch.threads MODEL --output RECEIPT.json
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import asdict
from importlib.metadata import version
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

import torch

from wyat import Model
from wyat.backends.kai.torch import KaiScorer
from wyat.benchmark import (
    BenchmarkCycle,
    BenchmarkEngine,
    QualityGate,
    _run,
    compare_cycles,
)
from wyat.evaluation import _input_digest, case_from_dict, percentile
from wyat.wire import decode_json

from ..evidence import freeze_sources, process_diagnostic
from ..reference import balanced_orders, read_reference
from ..scaling import ScalingPoint, fit_usl

THREAD_COUNTS = (1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12)
DATASET_SHA256 = "0020d9a3c72a21941ba551cf31f404187f69c6a5dc30299cc0a24d303b904a03"


def _digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def sweep(model_path: Path, output: Path, *, repeats: int = 6) -> dict[str, object]:
    orders = balanced_orders(THREAD_COUNTS, repeats)
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    dataset = root / "benchmarks/real/banking77-train-dev-menu6.jsonl"
    reference_path = root / "benchmarks/real/torch-fp32-reference77.json"
    sources = freeze_sources(
        {
            "runner": Path(__file__),
            "reference": root / "benchmarks/analysis/reference.py",
            "scaling": root / "benchmarks/analysis/scaling.py",
            "evidence": root / "benchmarks/analysis/evidence.py",
            "backend": root / "wyat/backends/kai/torch.py",
            "encoding": root / "wyat/backends/kai/encoding.py",
            "artifact": root / "wyat/backends/kai/artifact.py",
            "core": root / "wyat/core.py",
            "benchmark": root / "wyat/benchmark.py",
            "evaluation": root / "wyat/evaluation.py",
            "wire": root / "wyat/wire.py",
        },
        output,
    )
    reference_sha256 = _digest(reference_path)
    if _digest(dataset) != DATASET_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("Declared development cohort hash changed")
    cases = tuple(
        case_from_dict(decode_json(line)) for line in dataset.read_text().splitlines()
    )
    if len(cases) != 77:
        raise ValueError("Thread experiment requires all 77 declared cases")
    original_threads = torch.get_num_threads()
    interop_threads = torch.get_num_interop_threads()
    torch.set_num_threads(8)
    try:
        scorer = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model_path,
            device="cpu",
            max_length=512,
            token_cache_size=0,
            attention="sdpa",
        )
        reference = read_reference(
            reference_path, cases, scorer, dataset_sha256=DATASET_SHA256
        )
        model = Model(scorer, scorer.model_id)
        token_lengths = [len(scorer.encode_request(case.request).ids) for case in cases]
        engines = {
            count: BenchmarkEngine(f"torch-fp32-intraop{count}", model, 8)
            for count in THREAD_COUNTS
        }
        gate = QualityGate()
        warmup: dict[int, BenchmarkCycle] = {}
        measured: dict[int, list[BenchmarkCycle]] = {
            count: [] for count in THREAD_COUNTS
        }
        parallel: dict[int, str] = {}
        warmup_diagnostics: dict[int, dict[str, object]] = {}
        measured_diagnostics: dict[int, list[dict[str, object]]] = {
            count: [] for count in THREAD_COUNTS
        }
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        journal = output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl")
        with journal.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "stage": "setup",
                        "source_sha256": sources.hashes(),
                        "source_archive": sources.archive(),
                        "reference_sha256": reference_sha256,
                    },
                    allow_nan=False,
                )
                + "\n"
            )
            stream.flush()
            for count in THREAD_COUNTS:
                torch.set_num_threads(count)
                parallel[count] = torch.__config__.parallel_info()
                before = process_diagnostic()
                warmup[count] = _run(engines[count], cases)
                after = process_diagnostic()
                warmup_diagnostics[count] = {
                    "before": asdict(before),
                    "after": asdict(after),
                }
                stream.write(
                    json.dumps(
                        {
                            "stage": "warmup",
                            "intraop_threads": count,
                            "cycle": warmup[count].to_dict(),
                            "diagnostics": warmup_diagnostics[count],
                        },
                        allow_nan=False,
                    )
                    + "\n"
                )
                stream.flush()
            for repeat, order in enumerate(orders):
                for count in order:
                    torch.set_num_threads(count)
                    if (
                        torch.get_num_threads() != count
                        or torch.get_num_interop_threads() != interop_threads
                    ):
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            "Process thread settings changed unexpectedly"
                        )
                    before = process_diagnostic()
                    cycle = _run(engines[count], cases)
                    after = process_diagnostic()
                    measured[count].append(cycle)
                    diagnostics: dict[str, object] = {
                        "before": asdict(before),
                        "after": asdict(after),
                    }
                    measured_diagnostics[count].append(diagnostics)
                    stream.write(
                        json.dumps(
                            {
                                "stage": "measured",
                                "repeat": repeat,
                                "intraop_threads": count,
                                "cycle": cycle.to_dict(),
                                "diagnostics": diagnostics,
                            },
                            allow_nan=False,
                        )
                        + "\n"
                    )
                    stream.flush()
                print(
                    json.dumps(
                        {
                            "completed_round": repeat + 1,
                            "rounds": repeats,
                            "order": order,
                        }
                    ),
                    flush=True,
                )
        arms: dict[str, object] = {}
        points: list[ScalingPoint] = []
        all_passed = True
        for count in THREAD_COUNTS:
            cycles = tuple(measured[count])
            quality = compare_cycles((reference,) * repeats, cycles, gate)
            warmup_quality = compare_cycles((reference,), (warmup[count],), gate)
            passed = quality.passed and warmup_quality.passed
            all_passed &= passed
            seconds = math.fsum(cycle.latency_ms for cycle in cycles) / 1000
            attempted = len(cases) * repeats
            failed = sum(cycle.failed for cycle in cycles)
            rate = (attempted - failed) / seconds
            if passed:
                points.append(ScalingPoint(count, rate))
            baseline_cycles = measured[8]
            paired_speedups = [
                base.latency_ms / actual.latency_ms
                for base, actual in zip(baseline_cycles, cycles, strict=True)
            ]
            arms[str(count)] = {
                "passed": passed,
                "quality": asdict(quality),
                "warmup_quality": asdict(warmup_quality),
                "attempted": attempted,
                "failed": failed,
                "successful_requests_per_second": rate,
                "equivalent_requests_per_second": rate if passed else 0,
                "cycle_p50_ms": percentile([cycle.latency_ms for cycle in cycles], 0.5),
                "cycle_p95_ms": percentile(
                    [cycle.latency_ms for cycle in cycles], 0.95
                ),
                "batch_residence_p50_ms": percentile(
                    [row.latency_ms for cycle in cycles for row in cycle.rows], 0.5
                ),
                "batch_residence_p95_ms": percentile(
                    [row.latency_ms for cycle in cycles for row in cycle.rows], 0.95
                ),
                "same_round_speedups_vs8": paired_speedups,
                "same_round_speedup_p50_vs8": percentile(paired_speedups, 0.5),
                "measured_cycles": [cycle.to_dict() for cycle in cycles],
                "warmup_cycle": warmup[count].to_dict(),
                "parallel_info": parallel[count],
                "measured_diagnostics": measured_diagnostics[count],
                "warmup_diagnostics": warmup_diagnostics[count],
            }
        result: dict[str, object] = {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "scope": "configured ATen intraop-thread sweep; "
            "fixed full77 FP32 development cohort",
            "passed": all_passed,
            "model_id": scorer.model_id,
            "dataset_sha256": DATASET_SHA256,
            "reference_sha256": reference_sha256,
            "input_sha256": _input_digest(cases),
            "case_ids": [case.id for case in cases],
            "token_lengths": token_lengths,
            "environment": {
                "python": platform.python_version(),
                "platform": platform.platform(),
                "torch": version("torch"),
                "transformers": version("transformers"),
                "torch_build": torch.__config__.show(),
                "mkldnn_available": cast(
                    Callable[[], bool], torch.backends.mkldnn.is_available
                )(),
                "mkldnn_enabled": torch.backends.mkldnn.enabled,
                "interop_threads": interop_threads,
                "original_intraop_threads": original_threads,
                "thread_environment": {
                    key: os.environ.get(key)
                    for key in (
                        "OMP_NUM_THREADS",
                        "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
                        "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS",
                        "OMP_PROC_BIND",
                    )
                },
                "device": "cpu",
                "dtype": "float32",
                "autocast": False,
                "compile": False,
                "token_cache_size": 0,
            },
            "protocol": {
                "intraop_counts": THREAD_COUNTS,
                "batch_size": 8,
                "repeats": repeats,
                "warmup_per_count": 1,
                "orders": orders,
                "quality_gate": asdict(gate),
                "cohort_order": "canonical unchanged caller order",
                "setting_owner": "isolated benchmark process; "
                "intraop mutation per arm, interop fixed",
                "timing": "complete synchronous cohort; tokens, packing, forward, "
                "host results and decisions",
                "excludes": [
                    "loading",
                    "warmup",
                    "thread-setting mutation",
                    "receipt serialization",
                    "HTTP",
                    "queue",
                    "before/after diagnostic collection",
                ],
                "diagnostics": "untimed own-process cumulative rusage, OS load average "
                "and wall/monotonic timestamps; counters do not establish cause",
            },
            "counts": arms,
            "usl_descriptive_intraop_fit": asdict(fit_usl(points))
            if len(points) == 6
            else None,
            "source_sha256": sources.hashes(),
            "source_archive": sources.archive(),
            "limits": [
                "Configured ATen counts are not guaranteed Accelerate worker counts "
                "or uniform physical processors.",
                "Same-round ratios are balanced sweep diagnostics; "
                "any winner needs independent paired confirmation.",
                "No held-out model-quality claim; "
                "all original rows and failures retained.",
                "No measured DRAM bandwidth or independent sustained-compute ceiling.",
            ],
        }
        output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        return result
    finally:
        torch.set_num_threads(original_threads)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output",
        type=Path,
        default=Path("benchmarks/analysis/results/torch-threads77.json"),
    )
    parser.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=6)
    parser.add_argument("--timeout-seconds", type=float, default=600)
    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not math.isfinite(args.timeout_seconds) or args.timeout_seconds <= 0:
        parser.error("timeout must be finite and positive")
    if args.worker:
        result = sweep(args.model, args.output, repeats=args.repeats)
        print(
            json.dumps({"output": str(args.output), "model_id": result["model_id"]}),
            flush=True,
        )
        if not result["passed"]:
            sys.exit(1)
        return
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    timed_out = False
    exit_code: int | None = None
    command = [
        sys.executable,
        "-m",
        "benchmarks.analysis.torch.threads",
        str(args.model),
        "--output",
        str(args.output),
        "--repeats",
        str(args.repeats),
        "--worker",
    ]
    try:
        exit_code = subprocess.run(
            command, timeout=args.timeout_seconds, check=False
        ).returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
    receipt = {
        "elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter() - start,
        "timeout_seconds": args.timeout_seconds,
        "timed_out": timed_out,
        "exit_code": exit_code,
        "completed": not timed_out and exit_code == 0,
    }
    args.output.with_suffix(".wall.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n"
    )
    print(json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
    if not receipt["completed"]:
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Bounded, predeclared DMBench native interoperability assay; no score claim."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import platform
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from importlib.metadata import version
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, cast

from benchmarks.analysis.evidence import freeze_sources
from wyat import Model
from wyat.interop.dmbench import DMBenchRecipe, as_dmbench, as_dmbench_batch

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from dmbench.api import Case

RELEASE = "1e028905794498daba40a74cca8d826f965edb661879a725451bc222a3049dc0"
MODEL_ID = "kai:1f5525e01de43a724c71824579ef5195595fba916ce1e02be7bbbbea50f25cee"
RECIPE: DMBenchRecipe = "dmbench-native-choice-v1"
CACHE_BYTES = 512 << 20
UNSUPPORTED = tuple(f"clinc150/val/{index:06d}" for index in range(6))
LENGTH_ERROR = re.compile(
    r"^ValueError: ([0-9]+) tokens exceeds max_length=2048; no truncation$"
)


def object_value(value: object) -> dict[str, object]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or not all(isinstance(key, str) for key in value):
        raise ValueError("Expected an object")
    return cast(dict[str, object], value)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Outcome:
    id: str
    answer: str | None
    error: str | None
    probabilities: dict[str, float] | None


def outcomes(report: Mapping[str, object], ids: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[Outcome, ...]:
    rows = report.get("predictions")
    if report.get("count") != len(ids) or not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("Evaluator did not retain the complete denominator")
    values: list[Outcome] = []
    for raw in rows:
        row = object_value(raw)
        identifier, answer, error = row.get("id"), row.get("answer"), row.get("error")
        if not isinstance(identifier, str) or (
            answer is not None and not isinstance(answer, str)
        ):
            raise ValueError("Invalid evaluator identity or selected answer")
        if error is not None and not isinstance(error, str):
            raise ValueError("Invalid evaluator error")
        probabilities: dict[str, float] | None = None
        if row.get("probabilities") is not None:
            probabilities = {}
            for key, value in object_value(row["probabilities"]).items():
                if type(value) not in {int, float} or not math.isfinite(
                    cast(float, value)
                ):
                    raise ValueError("Invalid evaluator probability")
                probabilities[key] = float(cast(float, value))
        values.append(Outcome(identifier, answer, error, probabilities))
    if tuple(row.id for row in values) != ids:
        raise ValueError("Evaluator changed case IDs, order or count")
    return tuple(values)


def check_reports(
    scalar: Mapping[str, object],
    batch: Mapping[str, object],
    choices: Mapping[str, tuple[str, ...]],
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Compare admission and public predictions, never source gold or accuracy."""
    ids = tuple(choices)
    first, second = outcomes(scalar, ids), outcomes(batch, ids)
    problems: list[str] = []
    maximum = 0.0
    admitted = unsupported = selected_equal = 0
    for left, right in zip(first, second, strict=True):
        if (left.error is None) != (right.error is None):
            problems.append(f"{left.id}: scalar/batch status mismatch")
        if left.id in UNSUPPORTED:
            valid = True
            for row in (left, right):
                match = LENGTH_ERROR.fullmatch(row.error or "")
                if (
                    match is None
                    or int(match[1]) <= 2048
                    or row.answer is not None
                    or row.probabilities is not None
                ):
                    valid = False
            if valid:
                unsupported += 1
            else:
                problems.append(
                    f"{left.id}: expected intact overlength failure missing"
                )
            continue
        if left.error is not None or right.error is not None:
            problems.append(f"{left.id}: unexpected runtime failure")
            continue
        admitted += 1
        menu = choices[left.id]
        if left.answer != right.answer or left.answer not in menu:
            problems.append(f"{left.id}: selected answer changed or is outside menu")
        else:
            selected_equal += 1
        if any(
            row.probabilities is None or set(row.probabilities) != set(menu)
            for row in (left, right)
        ):
            problems.append(
                f"{left.id}: probability coverage differs from original menu"
            )
            continue
        assert left.probabilities is not None and right.probabilities is not None
        difference = max(
            abs(left.probabilities[key] - right.probabilities[key]) for key in menu
        )
        maximum = max(maximum, difference)
        if difference > 1e-4:
            problems.append(f"{left.id}: probability drift exceeds 1e-4")
    if len(ids) != 30 or unsupported != 6 or admitted != 24:
        problems.append("Expected six unsupported and 24 admitted cases across all 30")
    return {
        "passed": not problems,
        "total": len(ids),
        "expected_unsupported": unsupported,
        "admitted": admitted,
        "selected_equal": selected_equal,
        "max_absolute_probability_drift": maximum,
        "problems": problems,
    }


def read_assay(peer: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, object], tuple[Case, ...]]:
    from dmbench.api import strict_json_loads
    from dmbench.io import load_benchmark

    contract = object_value(
        strict_json_loads(
            (peer / "reports/wyat-native-dev-assay-contract.json").read_text()
        )
    )
    manifest, cases = load_benchmark(peer / "benchmarks/wyat-native-dev-assay")
    ids = [case.request.id for case in cases]
    if manifest != contract.get("manifest") or manifest.get("release_id") != RELEASE:
        raise ValueError("Assay differs from the bound manifest/release")
    if (
        len(cases) != 30
        or ids != contract.get("request_ids")
        or tuple(ids[:6]) != UNSUPPORTED
    ):
        raise ValueError("Assay changed its exact 30-case selection/order")
    if any(
        case.source != "CLINC/CLINC150-full"
        or case.split != "val"
        or len(case.request.choices) != 151
        for case in cases[:6]
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected six complete original CLINC val menus")
    if any(
        case.source != "authored-requirements-v1" or case.split != "dev"
        for case in cases[6:]
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected the complete authored development family")
    if sorted({len(case.request.choices) for case in cases}) != contract.get(
        "menu_sizes"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Assay menu sizes changed")
    return contract, cases


def write_receipt(output: Path, result: Mapping[str, object]) -> None:
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = output.with_suffix(output.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(output)


def assay(model_path: Path, peer: Path, output: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    """One scalar evaluation followed by explicit batch six on the same model."""
    result: dict[str, object] = {
        "completed": False,
        "passed": False,
        "stage": "preflight",
    }
    try:
        import dmbench
        from dmbench.evaluation import evaluate

        source = Path(dmbench.__file__).resolve().parent
        if source != (peer / "src/dmbench").resolve():
            raise ValueError("DMBench import does not match the declared peer checkout")
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
        paths = {
            "runner": Path(__file__),
            "contract": peer / "reports/wyat-native-dev-assay-contract.json",
            "manifest": peer / "benchmarks/wyat-native-dev-assay/manifest.json",
            "cases": peer / "benchmarks/wyat-native-dev-assay/cases.jsonl",
            "evidence": root / "benchmarks/analysis/evidence.py",
            "adapter": root / "wyat/interop/dmbench.py",
            "backend": root / "wyat/backends/kai/mlx.py",
            "encoding": root / "wyat/backends/kai/encoding.py",
            "artifact": root / "wyat/backends/kai/artifact.py",
            "core": root / "wyat/core.py",
            "loading": root / "wyat/loading/local.py",
            "wire": root / "wyat/wire.py",
            **{
                f"dmbench/{name}": source / name
                for name in (
                    "__init__.py",
                    "api.py",
                    "io.py",
                    "evaluation.py",
                    "adapters/native.py",
                )
            },
        }
        frozen = freeze_sources(paths, output)
        result.update(source_sha256=frozen.hashes(), source_archive=frozen.archive())
        contract, cases = read_assay(peer)
        result.update(
            {
                "schema_version": 1,
                "scope": (
                    "predeclared native-recipe interoperability diagnostic; "
                    "no performance or model-quality claim"
                ),
                "source_sha256": frozen.hashes(),
                "source_archive": frozen.archive(),
                "contract": contract,
                "release_id": RELEASE,
                "recipe": RECIPE,
                "case_ids": [case.request.id for case in cases],
                "model_artifact": str(model_path.resolve()),
                "protocol": {
                    "device": "mlx GPU",
                    "dtype": "float32",
                    "max_length": 2048,
                    "token_cache_size": 0,
                    "compile": False,
                    "cache_limit_bytes": CACHE_BYTES,
                    "order": ["scalar", "explicit_batch6"],
                    "timeout_seconds": 480,
                    "probability_atol": 1e-4,
                    "MLX_ENABLE_TF32": os.environ.get("MLX_ENABLE_TF32"),
                },
                "environment": {
                    "python": platform.python_version(),
                    "platform": platform.platform(),
                    "dmbench": dmbench.__version__,
                    "versions": {
                        name: version(name)
                        for name in ("mlx", "mlx-lm", "transformers", "safetensors")
                    },
                },
                "stage": "model_loading",
            }
        )
        write_receipt(output, result)
        if os.environ.get("MLX_ENABLE_TF32") != "0":
            raise ValueError(
                "FP32 assay requires MLX_ENABLE_TF32=0 before framework import"
            )
        import mlx.core as mx

        from wyat.backends.kai.mlx import MLXKaiScorer

        previous_limit = mx.set_cache_limit(CACHE_BYTES)
        try:
            scorer = MLXKaiScorer.from_directory(
                model_path,
                max_length=2048,
                device="gpu",
                token_cache_size=0,
                compile=False,
            )
            if scorer.model_id != MODEL_ID:
                raise ValueError("Loaded model differs from the pinned FP32 artifact")
            model = Model(scorer, scorer.model_id)
            result["model_id"] = model.model_id
            scalar = as_dmbench(model, recipe=RECIPE)
            result["scalar"] = evaluate(cases, scalar)
            result["stage"] = "scalar_complete"
            write_receipt(output, result)
            result["batch_size_6"] = evaluate(
                cases,
                scalar,
                batch=as_dmbench_batch(model, recipe=RECIPE),
                batch_size=6,
            )
            result["checks"] = check_reports(
                object_value(result["scalar"]),
                object_value(result["batch_size_6"]),
                {
                    case.request.id: tuple(choice.id for choice in case.request.choices)
                    for case in cases
                },
            )
            result["passed"] = object_value(result["checks"])["passed"]
            result["completed"] = True
            result["stage"] = "complete"
        finally:
            mx.set_cache_limit(previous_limit)
    except Exception as error:
        result["completed"] = False
        result["passed"] = False
        result["error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
    write_receipt(output, result)
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--peer", type=Path, default=Path("/Users/teilomillet/Code/dmbench")
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output",
        type=Path,
        default=Path("benchmarks/real/dmbench-native-dev-assay.json"),
    )
    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.worker:
        result = assay(args.model, args.peer, args.output)
        sys.exit(
            0 if result.get("completed") is True and result.get("passed") is True else 1
        )
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment["PYTHONPATH"] = (
        str(args.peer.resolve() / "src")
        + os.pathsep
        + environment.get("PYTHONPATH", "")
    )
    environment["MLX_ENABLE_TF32"] = "0"
    write_receipt(
        args.output, {"completed": False, "passed": False, "stage": "worker_start"}
    )
    start = time.perf_counter()
    timed_out = False
    exit_code: int | None = None
    error: str | None = None
    try:
        process = subprocess.run(
            [
                sys.executable,
                "-m",
                "benchmarks.real.dmbench.native",
                str(args.model),
                "--peer",
                str(args.peer),
                "--output",
                str(args.output),
                "--worker",
            ],
            env=environment,
            timeout=480,
            check=False,
        )
        exit_code = process.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        error = "Experiment exceeded its 480-second process cap"
    except OSError as exception:
        error = f"{type(exception).__name__}: {exception}"
    if error is not None:
        partial = (
            object_value(json.loads(args.output.read_text()))
            if args.output.exists()
            else {}
        )
        partial.update({"completed": False, "passed": False, "error": error})
        write_receipt(args.output, partial)
    wall = {
        "elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter() - start,
        "timeout_seconds": 480,
        "timed_out": timed_out,
        "exit_code": exit_code,
        "completed": exit_code == 0 and not timed_out,
    }
    write_receipt(args.output.with_suffix(".wall.json"), wall)
    sys.exit(0 if wall["completed"] else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

RECIPE = "dmbench-verbatim-choice-v1"


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def pilot(model_path: Path, dataset_path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    # Fix the prefix before any inference. Expected answers exist only in Cases.
    selected = tuple(
        case_from_dict(json.loads(line))
        for line in dataset_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[:4]
    )
    if len(selected) != 4:
        raise ValueError("DMBench native pilot requires the declared first four cases")
    cases = tuple(
        Case(
            DMBenchRequest(
                sample.id,
                "banking77/choice",
                sample.request.query,
                tuple(
                    Choice(choice.id, choice.text)
                    for choice in sample.request.candidates
                ),
            ),
            sample.expected,
            hashlib.sha256(
                " ".join(sample.request.query.casefold().split()).encode()
            ).hexdigest(),
            "PolyAI/BANKING77/train",
            "development",
        )
        for sample in selected
    )
    model = wyat.load(model_path, backend="mlx", device="gpu", token_cache_size=0)
    scalar, batch = as_dmbench(model), as_dmbench_batch(model)
    scalar_report = evaluate(cases, scalar)
    batch_report = evaluate(cases, scalar, batch=batch, batch_size=2)
    source = Path(dmbench.__file__).resolve().parent
    return {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "scope": "bounded native-engine interoperability exercise; not a performance "
        "comparison or official quality score",
        "model_id": model.model_id,
        "model_artifact": str(model_path.resolve()),
        "input_dataset_sha256": digest(dataset_path),
        "case_ids": [sample.id for sample in selected],
        "recipe": RECIPE,
        "input_contract": {
            "text": "original selected query verbatim",
            "choices": "original IDs, text and order",
            "context": "empty; source assay's classification instruction omitted",
            "expected": "independent dataset annotation in DMBench Case only",
        },
        "environment": {
            "platform": platform.platform(),
            "python": platform.python_version(),
            "device": "mlx GPU",
            "dtype": "float32",
            "compile": False,
            "token_cache_size": 0,
            "versions": {
                name: importlib.metadata.version(name)
                for name in ("mlx", "mlx-lm", "transformers", "safetensors")
            },
            "dmbench_version": dmbench.__version__,
        },
        "source_sha256": {
            "dmbench/api.py": digest(source / "api.py"),
            "dmbench/evaluation.py": digest(source / "evaluation.py"),
            "dmbench/__init__.py": digest(source / "__init__.py"),
            "wyat/interop/dmbench.py": digest(Path("wyat/interop/dmbench.py")),
            "reproducer": digest(Path(__file__)),
        },
        "scalar": scalar_report,
        "batch_size_2": batch_report,
        "limits": [
            "One execution per condition; no warmup or repeated timing protocol.",
            "Native model load excluded by DMBench inference timing.",
            "Both conditions share the same loaded model; scalar executes first.",
            "Four training-source queries; released model exposure is unknown.",
        ],
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dataset",
        type=Path,
        default=Path("benchmarks/real/banking77-train-dev-menu6.jsonl"),
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output", type=Path, default=Path("benchmarks/real/dmbench-native-pilot.json")
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = pilot(args.model, args.dataset)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "output": str(args.output),
                "model_id": result["model_id"],
                "case_ids": result["case_ids"],
            },
            indent=2,
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def test_original_prefix_rope_offset_negative_control(base: MLXKaiScorer) -> None:
    with mx.stream(mx.cpu):

def test_absolute_cached_mask_independent_uniform_gqa_oracle() -> None:
    with mx.stream(mx.cpu):
        positions = mx.array([0, 9, 3, 3], dtype=mx.int32)
        original_positions = positions + 5
        keys = mx.zeros((1, 1, 20, 16))
        values = mx.broadcast_to(
            mx.arange(20, dtype=mx.float32)[None, None, :, None], (1, 1, 20, 16)
        )
        queries = mx.zeros((1, 2, 4, 16))
        correct = mx.fast.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            queries,
            keys,
            values,
            scale=0.25,
            mask=mx.arange(20)[None, None, None, :]
            <= original_positions[None, None, :, None],
        )
        wrong = mx.fast.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            queries, keys, values, scale=0.25, mask="causal"
        )
        relative = mx.fast.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            queries,
            keys,
            values,
            scale=0.25,
            mask=mx.arange(20)[None, None, None, :] <= positions[None, None, :, None],
        )
        expected = mx.broadcast_to(
            (original_positions.astype(mx.float32) / 2)[None, None, :, None],
            (1, 2, 4, 16),
        )
        mx.eval(correct, wrong, relative, expected)
        assert bool(mx.allclose(correct, expected, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6).item())
        assert float(cast(float, mx.max(mx.abs(wrong - expected)).item())) > 5
        assert float(cast(float, mx.max(mx.abs(relative - expected)).item())) > 2

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

import pytest

import torch

def mlp() -> Qwen3MLP:
    constructor = cast(Callable[[Qwen3Config], Qwen3MLP], Qwen3MLP)
    result = constructor(Qwen3Config(hidden_size=8, intermediate_size=12))
    with torch.no_grad():
        for offset, parameter in enumerate(result.parameters()):
            parameter.copy_(
                torch.linspace(-0.15 + offset * 0.01, 0.1, parameter.numel()).reshape(
                    parameter.shape
                )
            )
    result.eval()
    return result


@settings(max_examples=12, deadline=None)
@given(batch=st.integers(1, 3), tokens=st.integers(1, 9))
def test_packing_matches_independent_projection_algebra(
    batch: int, tokens: int
) -> None:
    original = mlp()
    candidate = packing.PackedMLP(original)
    value = torch.linspace(-2, 2, batch * tokens * 8).reshape(batch, tokens, 8)
    with torch.inference_mode():
        gate = torch.nn.functional.linear(value, original.gate_proj.weight)
        up = torch.nn.functional.linear(value, original.up_proj.weight)
        expected = torch.nn.functional.linear(
            torch.nn.functional.silu(gate) * up, original.down_proj.weight
        )
        actual = candidate(value)
    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)
    assert candidate.gate_up.weight.dtype == torch.float32
    assert candidate.down_proj is original.down_proj
    assert not candidate.training
    assert torch.equal(candidate.gate_up.weight[:12], original.gate_proj.weight)
    assert torch.equal(candidate.gate_up.weight[12:], original.up_proj.weight)


def test_packed_storage_cannot_mutate_original_projections() -> None:
    original = mlp()
    before = original.gate_proj.weight.detach().clone()
    candidate = packing.PackedMLP(original)
    with torch.no_grad():
        candidate.gate_up.weight.zero_()
    assert torch.equal(original.gate_proj.weight, before)

def test_backbone_ownership_and_input_perturbation() -> None:
    config = Qwen3Config(
        vocab_size=40,
        hidden_size=16,
        intermediate_size=24,
        num_hidden_layers=2,
        num_attention_heads=2,
        num_key_value_heads=1,
        head_dim=8,
        max_position_embeddings=32,
    )
    original = Qwen3Model(config)
    cast(nn.Module, original).eval()
    before = dict(original.named_modules())
    candidate = packing.packed_backbone(original)
    assert candidate._modules is not original._modules
    assert candidate.layers is not original.layers
    for old, new in zip(original.layers, candidate.layers, strict=True):
        assert old is not new
        assert old._modules is not new._modules
        assert old.self_attn is new.self_attn
        assert old.mlp is not new.mlp
        old_mlp = cast(Qwen3MLP, old.mlp)
        new_mlp = cast(packing.PackedMLP, new.mlp)
        assert old_mlp.down_proj is new_mlp.down_proj
    assert dict(original.named_modules()) == before
    with torch.inference_mode():
        for ids in (torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3, 4], [4, 3, 2, 1]]), torch.tensor([[1, 3]])):
            expected = original(ids, use_cache=False).last_hidden_state
            actual = candidate(ids, use_cache=False).last_hidden_state
            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5)
    # Replacing a candidate-owned child cannot overwrite the baseline dictionary.
    candidate.layers[0].mlp = nn.Identity()
    assert original.layers[0].mlp is before["layers.0.mlp"]

def hidden(base: KaiScorer, ids: torch.Tensor, candidate: PrefixScorer) -> torch.Tensor:
    with torch.inference_mode():
        output = cast(
            BaseModelOutputWithPast,
            base.backbone(
                input_ids=ids,
                past_key_values=candidate.fork(ids.shape[0]),
                use_cache=True,
            ),
        )
        assert output.last_hidden_state is not None
        return output.last_hidden_state

)
def test_cached_suffix_matches_independent_full_model_and_future_causality(
    base: KaiScorer, prefix_length: int, suffix_length: int, batch: int
) -> None:
    vocab = base.backbone.config.vocab_size
    prefix = tuple((index * 3 + 1) % vocab for index in range(prefix_length))
    candidate = PrefixScorer(base, prefix)
    suffix = (
        torch.arange(batch * suffix_length).reshape(batch, suffix_length) + 2
    ) % vocab
    full = torch.cat((torch.tensor([prefix]).expand(batch, -1), suffix), dim=1)
    with torch.inference_mode():
        expected = base.backbone(input_ids=full, use_cache=False).last_hidden_state[
            :, prefix_length:
        ]
        actual = hidden(base, suffix, candidate)
    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5)
    perturbed = suffix.clone()
    perturbed[:, -1] = (perturbed[:, -1] + 1) % vocab
    changed = hidden(base, perturbed, candidate)
    # An independent future-token intervention cannot affect earlier readouts.
    torch.testing.assert_close(changed[:, :-1], actual[:, :-1], atol=0, rtol=0)

@settings(
    max_examples=8,
    deadline=None,
    suppress_health_check=[HealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture],
)
@given(repeats=st.integers(1, 6), count=st.integers(2, 4))
def test_both_common_paths_match_independent_full_and_original_stock(
    base: KaiScorer,
    repeats: int,
    count: int,
) -> None:
    requests = (request(), request("write? " * repeats, count))
    prefix = base.encode_request(requests[0]).ids[:2]
    legacy = PrefixScorer(base, prefix)
    full = base.score_many(requests)
    stock = legacy.score_many(requests)
    for arm in ("retained", "one-use"):
        scorer = MemoryScorer(base, prefix, arm)
        snapshots = tuple((k.clone(), v.clone()) for k, v in scorer._states)
        first = scorer.score_many(requests)
        scorer.score_many(requests[::-1])
        again = scorer.score_many(requests)
        observed: list[StorageObservation] = []
        instrumented = scorer.score_observed(requests, observed.append)
        for actual in (first, again, instrumented):
            for a, f, s in zip(actual, full, stock, strict=True):
                torch.testing.assert_close(
                    torch.tensor(a), torch.tensor(f), atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5
                )
                torch.testing.assert_close(
                    torch.tensor(a), torch.tensor(s), atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5
                )
        assert first == again and scorer.score_many(()) == []
        assert [item.layer for item in observed] == [None, 0, 1]
        for state, expected in zip(scorer._states, snapshots, strict=True):
            assert torch.equal(state[0], expected[0]) and torch.equal(
                state[1], expected[1]
            )
        # Stored evidence has primitive values only, never Tensor/Storage owners.
        assert all(
            all(value is None or type(value) is int for value in asdict(item).values())
            for item in observed
        )
    assert base.backbone.config.use_cache is False

def fake_study(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    """Pure fake logits/observers test journal and failure policy, never real RSS."""
    from types import TracebackType

    from transformers.integrations import sdpa_attention

    from wyat.evaluation import EvaluationCase, EvaluationRow

    prefix = tuple(cast(list[int], history["prefix_tokens"]))

            width = len(value.candidates)
            return EncodedRequest(
                prefix + tuple(range(width + 2)),
                tuple(range(25, 25 + width)),
                26 + width,
            )

        def score_many(self, values: Sequence[Request]) -> list[list[float]]:
            return [
                [float(-i) for i in range(len(value.candidates))] for value in values
            ]

            assert tokens == prefix

            return row.ids[:25] == prefix

        def score_observed(
            self, values: Sequence[Request], observer: object
        ) -> list[list[float]]:
            from benchmarks.analysis.torch.prefix.memory.scorer import Observer

            callback = cast(Observer, observer)
            callback(StorageObservation(None, 8 * 123, 0, 9 * 123))
            for layer in range(28):
                callback(StorageObservation(layer, 100, 200, 300))
            return self.score_many(values)

    class FakeSampler:
        def __enter__(self) -> FakeSampler:
            return self

        def __exit__(
            self,
            kind: type[BaseException] | None,
            error: BaseException | None,
            traceback: TracebackType | None,
        ) -> None:
            return None

        def report(self) -> MemoryReport:
            return MemoryReport(
                True,
                20_000_000,
                512,
                30.0,
                False,
                False,
                1,
                (20_000_000,) * 4,
                0,
                80_000_000,

                (20_000_000,) * 4,
                (),
                None,
                1000,
                (),
            )

"""Owned-group timeout checks without spawning compilers or loading tensors."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import signal
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from benchmarks.analysis.torch import process
from wyat.wire import read_object


def test_timeout_kills_only_owned_group_and_reaps(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    waited: list[float | None] = []
    signals: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    creation: list[dict[str, object]] = []

    class Child:
        pid = 12345

        def wait(self, timeout: float | None = None) -> int:
            waited.append(timeout)
            if timeout is not None:
                raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired("owned worker", timeout)
            return -9

    def popen(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> Child:
        creation.append({"command": args[0], **kwargs})
        return Child()

    def killpg(group: int, sig: int) -> None:
        signals.append((group, sig))

    monkeypatch.setattr(subprocess, "Popen", popen)
    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "killpg", killpg)
    output = tmp_path / "run.json"
    assert (
        process.launch(
            "benchmarks.analysis.torch.autotune",
            tmp_path / "model",
            output,
            timeout=0.01,
            worker_args=("--batch-size", "1"),
        )
        == 124
    )
    assert signals == [(Child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)]
    assert waited == [0.01, None]
    assert creation[0]["start_new_session"] is True
    command = creation[0]["command"]
    assert isinstance(command, list)
    assert command[-3:] == ["--batch-size", "1", "--worker"]
    environment = creation[0]["env"]
    assert isinstance(environment, dict)
    assert environment["TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS"] == "1"
    assert environment["TORCHINDUCTOR_FREEZING"] == "1"
    receipt = read_object(output.with_suffix(".wall.json"))
    assert receipt["timed_out"] is True
    assert receipt["completed"] is False
    assert not output.exists()

        process.launch("unused", tmp_path / "model", output, timeout=1)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("failure", ["save", "restore", "source", "partial"])
def test_late_failure_resets_flags_and_preserves_observed_rows(
    base: KaiScorer,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    failure: str,
) -> None:
    # Fake accelerator transport/counters; only the tiny CPU modules execute.
    from collections.abc import Iterator
    from contextlib import contextmanager, nullcontext

    from benchmarks.analysis.cuda.manifest import DATA, ROOT
    from wyat.evaluation import case_from_dict
    from wyat.wire import decode_json

    cases = tuple(
        case_from_dict(decode_json(line))
        for line in (ROOT / DATA).read_text().splitlines()
    )
    rows = tuple(
        EvaluationRow(
            case.id,
            case.expected,
            "ok",
            decision_from_logits(
                case.request,
                tuple(float(i) for i in range(len(case.request.candidates))),
                MODEL_ID,
            ),
            False,
            0,
            None,
        )
        for case in cases
    )
    cycle = BenchmarkCycle(1, rows, 0, 0)
    admissions = 0

    def admit(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
        nonlocal admissions
        admissions += 1
        if failure == "source" and admissions > 1:
            raise ValueError("changed source probe")
        return {}

    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "admit", admit)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        runner, "load_artifact", lambda *args: SimpleNamespace(model_id=MODEL_ID)
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "occupancy", lambda **kwargs: {})
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "read_reference", lambda *args, **kwargs: cycle)
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "ieee_precision", nullcontext)
    if failure == "restore":

        @contextmanager
        def restore_failure() -> Iterator[None]:
            yield
            raise RuntimeError("restore probe")

        monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "ieee_precision", restore_failure)
    monkeypatch.setattr(KaiScorer, "from_directory", lambda *args, **kwargs: base)
    monkeypatch.setattr(nn.Module, "to", lambda self, *args, **kwargs: self)
    for name in (
        "reset_peak_memory_stats",
        "memory_allocated",
        "memory_reserved",
        "max_memory_allocated",
        "max_memory_reserved",
    ):
        monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, name, lambda: 0)

    calls = 0

    def fake_run(engine: object, batch: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...]) -> BenchmarkCycle:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        if failure == "partial" and calls == 3:
            raise RuntimeError("partial probe")
        modules = dict(cast(nn.Module, base.backbone).named_modules())
        for _ in batch:
            modules["layers.0.self_attn.q_proj"](torch.zeros(1, 16))
            modules["layers.0.mlp.gate_proj"](torch.zeros(1, 16))
            base.head(torch.zeros(1, 1, 16), torch.zeros(1, 16))
        ids = {case.id for case in batch}
        return BenchmarkCycle(
            1, tuple(row for row in cycle.rows if row.id in ids), 0, 0
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "_run", fake_run)
    original_write = Path.write_text
    failed = False

    def write(path: Path, data: str, *args: object, **kwargs: object) -> int:
        nonlocal failed
        if failure == "save" and not failed and '"completed": true' in data:
            failed = True
            raise OSError("final-save probe")
        return original_write(path, data)

    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_text", write)
    path = tmp_path / "late.json"
    manifest = tmp_path / "manifest"
    manifest.write_text("fixture")
    assert not runner.study(
        tmp_path / "model",
        path,
        manifest=manifest,
        manifest_sha256=digest(manifest),
        arm="fp32",
        batch_size=1,
    )
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text())
    if failure == "partial":
        assert payload["completed_rows"] == 2 and len(payload["unknown_case_ids"]) == 75
        assert "cycle" not in payload
    else:
        assert payload["cycle"]["rows"] == cycle.to_dict()["rows"]
    assert payload["completed"] is payload["quality_passed"] is False
    assert "probe" in payload["error"]
    assert not base.head._forward_hooks

def tensor(value: mx.array) -> torch.Tensor:
    return torch.tensor(cast(list[list[float]], value.tolist()), dtype=torch.float32)


def oracle(original: MLP, value: torch.Tensor, arm: Arm) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Independent Torch CPU Linear/SwiGLU with explicit declared rounding."""
    gate_up = arm != "all-down"
    down = arm != "all-gate-up"
    operand = value.to(torch.bfloat16) if gate_up else value
    dtype = torch.bfloat16 if gate_up else torch.float32
    gate = torch.nn.functional.linear(
        operand, tensor(original.gate_proj.weight).to(dtype)
    ).float()
    up = torch.nn.functional.linear(
        operand, tensor(original.up_proj.weight).to(dtype)
    ).float()
    activation = torch.nn.functional.silu(gate) * up
    operand = activation.to(torch.bfloat16) if down else activation
    weight = (
        tensor(original.down_proj.weight).to(torch.bfloat16)
        if down
        else tensor(original.down_proj.weight)
    )
    return torch.nn.functional.linear(operand, weight).float()

def write_bits(path: Path, bits: list[int]) -> TensorSpan:
    path.write_bytes(struct.pack(f"<{len(bits)}H", *bits))
    return TensorSpan("probe", (1, len(bits)), 0, len(bits))


def test_exact_range_and_bf16_exponent_counterexamples(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    # ±1, signed zeros and the smallest half subnormal are exact. BF16 has
    # smaller subnormals and larger finite values that half cannot preserve.
    bits = [0x3F80, 0xBF80, 0, 0x8000, 0x3380, 0x0001, 0x7F7F]
    path = tmp_path / "bits"
    result = scan_tensor(path, write_bits(path, bits), chunk_elements=2)
    assert result.elements == 7
    assert result.source_nonfinite == 0
    assert result.mismatches == 2
    assert result.underflow_to_zero == 1
    assert result.source_subnormal == 1
    assert result.overflow == 1
    assert not result.eligible


def test_half_subnormal_grid_rounding_is_not_zero_underflow(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "bits"
    # 2**-24 + 2**-31 is BF16-representable but not a half subnormal grid point.
    result = scan_tensor(path, write_bits(path, [0x3381]))
    assert result.mismatches == 1
    assert result.underflow_to_zero == result.overflow == 0
    assert result.max_finite_absolute_error == 2**-31

@given(st.lists(st.integers(0, 65535), min_size=1, max_size=64))
def test_chunked_scan_matches_independent_python_half_oracle(bits: list[int]) -> None:
    # NamedTemporaryFile avoids Hypothesis retaining a pytest tmp_path fixture.
    from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

    expected_mismatch = expected_nonfinite = 0
    for word in bits:
        value = struct.unpack("<f", struct.pack("<I", word << 16))[0]
        expected_nonfinite += not math.isfinite(value)
        try:
            restored = struct.unpack("<e", struct.pack("<e", value))[0]
        except OverflowError:
            restored = math.copysign(math.inf, value)
        expected_mismatch += value != restored
    with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        path = Path(directory) / "bits"
        span = write_bits(path, bits)
        result = scan_tensor(path, span, chunk_elements=3)
        assert result.mismatches == expected_mismatch
        assert result.source_nonfinite == expected_nonfinite
        assert result.eligible == (expected_mismatch == expected_nonfinite == 0)


def fixture_file(path: Path, *, change: str = "") -> None:
    header: dict[str, object] = {}
    for index, role in enumerate(("gate_proj", "up_proj", "down_proj")):
        shape = [2, 1] if role != "down_proj" else [1, 2]
        header[f"layers.0.mlp.{role}.weight"] = {
            "dtype": "BF16",
            "shape": shape,
            "data_offsets": [4 * index, 4 * index + 4],
        }
    first = header["layers.0.mlp.gate_proj.weight"]
    assert isinstance(first, dict)
    if change == "dtype":
        first["dtype"] = "F16"
    elif change == "shape":
        first["shape"] = [True, 2]
    elif change == "outside":
        first["data_offsets"] = [100, 104]
    elif change == "overlap":
        first["data_offsets"] = [4, 8]
    elif change == "short":
        first["data_offsets"] = [0, 2]
    encoded = json.dumps(header).encode()
    path.write_bytes(struct.pack("<Q", len(encoded)) + encoded + bytes(12))

from hypothesis import strategies as st

pytest.importorskip("mlx.core")

from benchmarks.analysis.mlx.padding import Microbatches  # noqa: E402
from wyat import Candidate, Request  # noqa: E402
from wyat.backends.kai.encoding import EncodedRequest  # noqa: E402


class Oracle:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.batches: list[tuple[str, ...]] = []

    def encode_request(self, request: Request) -> EncodedRequest:
        return EncodedRequest(tuple(range(len(request.query))), (0, 1), 1)

    def score_many(self, requests: Sequence[Request]) -> list[list[float]]:
        self.batches.append(tuple(request.query for request in requests))
        return [[float(sum(map(ord, request.query))), 0.0] for request in requests]


@given(
    queries=st.lists(st.text(alphabet="abc", min_size=1, max_size=12), max_size=20),
    size=st.integers(1, 8),
    sort=st.booleans(),
)
def test_scheduler_preserves_duplicates_cardinality_and_original_order(
    queries: list[str], size: int, sort: bool
) -> None:
    requests = [
        Request(query=query, candidates=(Candidate("a", "yes"), Candidate("b", "no")))
        for query in queries
    ]
    oracle = Oracle()
    actual = Microbatches(oracle, size, sort=sort).score_many(requests)
    assert actual == [[float(sum(map(ord, query))), 0.0] for query in queries]
    observed = [query for batch in oracle.batches for query in batch]
    assert observed == (sorted(queries, key=len) if sort else queries)
    assert all(0 < len(batch) <= size for batch in oracle.batches)
    assert not queries or len(oracle.batches) == (len(queries) + size - 1) // size


@pytest.mark.parametrize("size", [0, -1, True])
def test_scheduler_rejects_invalid_batch_size(size: int) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Microbatches(Oracle(), size, sort=True)

class CharacterTokenizer:
    pad_token_id = 0
    eos_token_id = 0

    def encode(self, text: str, *, add_special_tokens: bool = False) -> list[int]:
        return [ord(character) % 128 for character in text]


def request(choices: Sequence[str], *, context: str = "shared public state") -> Request:
    return Request(
        query="Pick the action.",
        context=context,
        candidates=tuple(
            Candidate(str(index), text) for index, text in enumerate(choices)
        ),
    )
